jobs.title: Senior Public Equity Analyst (125310)
jobs.description: Your teamPictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The partner-owned financial services group offers comprehensive services for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.The Pictet Investment Office (PIO) is a specialised investment team within Pictet Wealth Management, dedicated to serving a select group of large families and principals. It manages substantial wealth portfolios through a distinctive approach that combines investments across public and private markets, with a strong emphasis on equity ownership and concentrated conviction.The service is designed for large wealth owners with a multi-generational horizon and limited liquidity requirements, allowing them to fully benefit from the power of compounding. PIO’s investment philosophy centres on long-term business ownership, unconstrained capital allocation, and the belief that permanent capital loss, rather than volatility, is the only real risk. This exclusive offering operates within Pictet’s broader wealth management business, which oversees CHF 277bn in assets and provides comprehensive, bespoke private banking services.Your roleInvestment idea generation: Identify and develop high-conviction, long-term, long-only investment opportunities in US and European markets.Fundamental analysis: Perform comprehensive due diligence on investment ideas, including industry analysis, financial modelling and valuation. Engage directly with company management and perform primary research to support investment theses.Sector coverage: Cover sectors as assigned, with flexibility to adapt as team needs evolve. Experience in the sectors in which we principally invest is advantageous but not required (technology, business services, non-bank financials, healthcare services and devices, industrial technologies, infrastructure).Reporting and communication: Prepare and present investment reports and recommendations to the team and investment leadership.Curiosity: Actively engage on team debate and discussions that sit outside of your area of expertise. Contribute to building the team’s broad-based knowledge and experience set to enhance the quality of investment debate.Team collaboration: Work closely with other analysts to share ideas, insights and best practices in a highly collaborative and entrepreneurial environment.Cross asset class: Contribute to the research effort on other asset classes, including Private Equity and Hedge Funds where necessary.Data and process improvement: Leverage investment experience to support data-driven projects and process improvements, including the integration of advanced analytics and emerging AI tools.Your profileEducation: Graduate degree from a top-tier university with an outstanding academic record.Experience: Minimum of 10 years in sell-side or buy-side roles (asset management, hedge funds, or private equity). Experience in fundamental, long-term orientated investment process is preferred.Technical skills: Advanced proficiency in Excel and data management. Experience or interest in data-driven projects and process improvement; familiarity with AI concepts is preferred.Languages: Fluency in English required. Additional languages are a plus.Passion: Can demonstrate a deep passion for investing, exceptionally curious to understand why some companies win or lose, and what will shape industries, and sectors and companies in the future.Financial and investment excellence: Strong grounding in fundamental analysis and financial modelling skills with the ability to generate high conviction, long-term investment ideas in a rigorous quality and fundamentally based framework.Analytical mindset: Thrives in an evidence-based, truth-seeking culture. Exceptional proficiency in Excel and data organization. Comfortable and open to learning and implementing new technologies and AI-enhanced processes.Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present investment ideas and reports clearly and persuasively to both internal and external stakeholders.Teamwork: Strong collaborative, entrepreneurial spirit, with a focus on both contributing ideas and supporting the team’s collective success through active debate and discussion on the entire team’s work.Integrity: High ethical standards and alignment with the values and culture of the Pictet Investment Office.Intellectual curiosity: Deep passion for investing and a desire to continuously learn and improve. Work ethic: Highly motivated, proactive and results-oriented.Integrity: Unwavering commitment to ethical behaviour and professional standards.Diversity & InclusionPictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.title: Senior Analog/Mixed-Signal IC Design Specialist
jobs.description: EinleitungstextThe Microelectronics Design Center (DZ) of the Department of Information Technologies and Electrical Engineering (D-ITET) is a technical support group providing design tools, know-how and licenses for ASIC, FPGA, Embedded Systems and PCB design for research and teaching . This includes consulting, project planning, reviewing of active projects as well as participation in projects. To lead the area of Analog/Mixed-Signal IC Design we are seeking a Senior Analog/Mixed-Signal IC Design Specialist starting 1st of January 2027 or by mutual agreement.Aufgaben-/StellenbeschreibungYou will be part of an experienced team and be the expert for analog/mixed-signal in the DZ.You will own the analog/mixed-signal area of the IC design infrastructure and further develop it with the aim to provide support to researchers and students.You will support design flows covering all aspects of IC design with a strong focus on analog/mixed-signal design flows using the latest tools from Cadence Design System, Synopsys, Mentor Graphics and open-source tools.You will interact with students and researchers to help them with their IC design related questions, chip finishing and submission of ICs to fabrication through MPW and foundry contacts.You will also be asked to develop, adapt and maintain common building blocks for mixed-signal IC chips as well as the development of larger mixed-signal ICs.As part of a team supporting research and teaching at ETH Zurich, you will frequently be challenged to develop solutions for systems that stretch the boundaries of conventional approaches.You will be asked to help researchers and students through design reviews.You will also develop and deliver targeted training modules and hands-on laboratory sessions for students and researchers in these areas.In addition, you will contribute to the group's outreach and visibility by supporting its web presence and preparing periodic activity reports.Ihr ProfilWe are looking for an experienced IC designer with strong expertise in analog/mixed-signal design, motivated to work in an environment where creative technical problem-solving supports researchers and students. Given the level and breadth of the technical challenges involved, a PhD in Electrical or Computer Engineering is preferred. Candidates should bring at least 5 years of IC design experience, gained in industry or at a qualified research institution, including hands-on familiarity with tape-out procedures. A track record of multiple successful analog/mixed-signal tape-outs across a range of technology nodes, including advanced ones such as 22nm and FinFET, is required, as is experience leading chip tape-out projects. Proficiency with UNIX, scripting languages, and IC design tools from major EDA vendors is also required. Good written and spoken English is essential for technical collaboration in a multicultural environment. Experience organizing technical training courses and undergraduate laboratory activities is highly desirable. The ideal candidate combines strong communication and technical skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences and is comfortable taking on a leading and senior technical role within the team.Wir bietenWe are a small support team of four permanent employees, and are looking forward to add a fifth member to the team. As a support group we expect you to be present mostly in the office to interact with students and research staff, however we can accommodate some home office hours per week as long as it aligns with the rest of the group. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity in our team. We are most interested in finding the best candidate for the job and that candidate may be one who comes from a less traditional background. If you are interested in this role but your past experience does not align perfectly with every qualification, we still encourage you to apply.Neugierig? Sind wir auch.We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:A letter of motivationCVDiplomasCertificates of employmentThe application deadline is 30 November 2026.Further information about Microelectronics Design Center can be found on our Website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Frank K. Gürkaynak, +41 44 632 2726 or kgf@iis.ee.ethz.ch (no applications).Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.We would like to point out that the pre-selection is carried out by the responsible recruiters and not by artificial intelligence.For recruitment services the GTC of ETH Zurich apply.

jobs.title: Lab Manager and Experimental Technical Support Staff
jobs.description: EinleitungstextAt the IDEAL Lab, we develop algorithms and computational models that design physical hardware and validate those designs via physical experiments. We have a growing physical footprint that includes 3D printers, a custom foam cutter, several robotic arms (UR5e), and a variety of small mechatronic test rigs that change depending on the project. We also have a large teaching profile with ~20-30 Bachelor's and Master's students joining the lab each semester for various projects, a subset of which involve robotics or mechatronics-related experiments.ProjekthintergrundWe are looking for a part-time technical staff member to act as a Lab Manager and/or coordinating technician, depending on the skillset of the person. The specific roles and responsibilities of this person — and the amount of time/effort required from them — would depend on what they could do based on their experience or desire for future training/growth. The core task would be basic lab operations and safety, as mentioned below — anticipated ~20% time — with an optional/desired role for additional time being the engineering and student support — initially anticipated at 20% time, however, this has the option to grow in the future depending on the skills, usefulness, and desires of the specific candidate.Aufgaben-/StellenbeschreibungBasic Lab Operations and Safety (~20% time):Act as the General Safety Representative for the lab. Train incoming students/staff on safety rules and how to use shared equipment (trainings occur 3-4 times per year for 1-2 hours). Update the safety concept, e.g., once per year or as needed.Keep the lab spaces operational, such as managing inventory, handling purchase requests for supplies, retrieving packages as needed, and working with students to ensure workstations are kept clean and organized. Coordinate the once-a-year lab cleaning day with staff.Coordinate with staff and students on the maintenance and use of shared equipment such as the 3D printers, robots, and hand tools, as well as repairs when things break, as per the safety concept. This can include delegating tasks to existing staff if appropriate.Act as a point of contact for student questions about where equipment or supplies are located in the lab space. Generally share personal knowledge and maintain personal relationships. Guide students toward other ETH resources (like other technical workshops or facilities) outside of our immediate lab’s perimeter when they have specific questions/needs (e.g., ETH TechPool, off-site laser cutters, Instron machines, etc.).Attend any occasional lab operational meetings with the PI and other staff, or lab retreats as desired, although not recurring lab meetings (unless desired).Engineering and Student Support (~20% time):Where appropriate, support research goals by helping or consulting with students and staff to debug and run physical experiments they have planned. This could include helping them build or debug necessary rigs or platforms for various research projects, automating existing procedures from past research projects to make them easier to extend in the future, or building working knowledge of the lab’s robotic infrastructure to more quickly onboard new student projects. This depends on the specific hands-on skills of the individual candidate, and also the project needs, as existing students/staff will be the ones largely responsible for setting up and maintaining their own infrastructure.Support research goals by coordinating with outside/external partners, for example, ETH TechPool, outside contractors, researchers at other labs or institutions, etc. to deliver or maintain necessary experimental equipment.Maintain the operation of a few lab demos for occasional visitors.Assist, as requested, Ph.D. students and Post-Docs with transitioning their student projects between semesters, e.g., from one set of Thesis students to another, in cases where the project has a physical experiment setup that uses the lab space. jobs.title: Semiconductor Metrology & Quality Control Technician – 100%
jobs.description: Are you the person who enjoy precise, hands-on work with wafers and chips in a cleanroom, and operating metrology equipment such as optical microscopes, die-sorting, SEM? At Lightium, we're building the next generation of thin-film lithium niobate photonic integrated circuits to help AI infrastructure run faster. As we move from development toward volume production, we're looking for a Metrology & Quality Control Technician to own the measurement, inspection and sorting of our wafers and chips, and to make sure every part that leaves Lightium is exactly what our customers expect. Position Summary As part of our Operations team, you will be the day-to-day responsible for metrology and quality control, as well as die sorting and packaging in our semiconductor cleanroom. You will characterize wafers and chips with a broad set of metrology tools (including optical microscopes, SEM), run incoming and outgoing inspection, operate the pick-and-place machine for die sorting and package and document our products with full traceability. You will work closely with our process, design and test engineers, as well as with fab partners and suppliers. Precision and reliable execution are at the core of the job, and your experience will help shape the way we measure, inspect and release our products as we scale. Key Responsibilities Metrology: Perform wafer- and chip-level measurements using SEM, stylus profilometer, optical and confocal microscopes, and ellipsometer (e.g., film thickness, critical dimensions, etch depth and step height, surface topography and defects). Set up and maintain measurement recipes, keep tools calibrated and in good working condition, and coordinate with service providers when needed.  Sorting & Packaging: Sort chips and dies by hand using manual and vacuum tweezers, as well as operate our pick & place machine to sort dies from singulated wafers on tape to industry-standards shipping containers such as GelPak, waffle pack, JEDEC tray. Handle wafer taping, die marking, final sorting, packaging and sealing in vacuum bags. Data & Reporting: Record, analyze and report measurement results in a clear and traceable way, compliant with our data-stack and data ingestion processes. Promptly flag out-of-spec results and deviations to engineering, support root-cause investigations, and help trend key parameters over time. Incoming Quality Control: Inspect incoming wafers, chips and critical materials from fab partners and suppliers against specifications, complete goods acceptance documentation, and handle nonconforming material in coordination with internal stakeholders. Outgoing Quality Control: Perform final visual and dimensional inspection of chips and wafers before shipment, prepare Certificates of Conformance (CoC) and inspection reports for customers, and ensure that packaging meets our quality standards. Traceability: Ensure full traceability of every wafer and chip through consistent labeling and identification, keep inventory and traceability records accurate in our ERP, PLM system for data traceability, and help maintain the same standards across our R&D and production lines. Procedures & Improvement: Contribute to writing and updating work instructions and inspection and measurement procedures as part of our growing quality management system, and suggest practical improvements based on your daily work, including suggestions for engineers for better automations and improvements of our MES system.  What you’ll bring Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in metrology and quality control in semiconductor, photonics, MEMS or a related micro- and nanofabrication environment such as watch industry and medical instruments. Technical education such as an EFZ apprenticeship (e.g., Mikrotechnologe/in, Physiklaborant/in), a higher technical diploma, or an FH degree in a related field. Metrology Know-how: Hands-on operation of SEM, profilometry, optical and confocal microscopy, ellipsometry, as well as pick-and-place machine for die sorting. Solid experience and dexterity with manual handling of wafers and chips with tweezers. Solid understanding of inspection criteria for wafers and dies. Cleanroom Experience: Proven experience working in ISO 5 / ISO 6 cleanrooms and gray-rooms, operating cleanroom equipment ensuring compliance with cleanroom requirements, as well as preventive and regular maintenance and calibration of tools. Precision & Work Ethic: Meticulous, reliable and hardworking. You take pride in getting things right the first time and in documenting your work so others can trust your results. Quality Mindset: Familiarity with quality standards (e.g., ISO 9001), nonconformance handling and traceability. Experience preparing CoCs or inspection reports is a plus. Tools: Comfortable with Microsoft 365, especially Excel for data analysis. Experience with ERP and PLM systems as well as automation and MES is a plus. Interested in using AI tools such as Claude in your daily work. Language Skills: Good English is preferred. German or French or Italian is a plus.

jobs.title: Healthcare Patent Counsel, Digital Health (all genders)
jobs.description: Healthcare Patent Counsel, Digital Health (all genders)Your rôleAs Healthcare Patent Counsel, you will shape the U.S. and global intellectual property strategy for pharmaceutical development projects and commercial products, with a particular focus on digital health and integrated healthcare solutions. You will work at the intersection of pharmaceuticals, software, data, medical devices, and digital health to protect innovation and enable successful development and commercialization. Partnering with scientists, software experts, engineers, and other innovators, you will identify inventions and build patent portfolio strategies that support project and business objectives. Your work will span combination products, software-enabled medical devices, biomarkers, algorithms, data-driven solutions, and connected health ecosystems. You will draft, file, and prosecute patent applications in the United States, Europe, and other international jurisdictions. You will manage oppositions, post-grant proceedings, and other validity matters, including PGRs and IPRs. You will conduct and oversee freedom-to-operate analyses, turn complex findings into clear recommendations, and support patent enforcement, invalidation proceedings, and related legal opinions. You will provide intellectual property advice and negotiation support for contracts, collaborations, licenses, and business development transactions. As part of an expert group for Digital IP, you will advise colleagues across business areas on software, data analysis, and emerging digital technologies. Working closely with Pharmaceutical R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Commercial, Business Development, and Legal teams, you will counsel senior leaders and help define the future of digital healthcare in a collaborative international environment. Who you are•    You hold a university degree in biomedical engineering, chemistry, biology, pharmaceutical sciences, or a related scientific discipline, together with strong bioinformatics expertise.•    You are registered to practice before the European Patent Office (EPO) and/or the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO).•    You bring substantial experience in a patent department within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or life sciences industry, or in a law firm advising on digital health, software, medical devices, or related healthcare technologies.•    You have a strong understanding of patentability and legal issues relating to software, artificial intelligence and machine learning, data analytics, digital biomarkers, and personalized healthcare.•    You have demonstrated experience in patent drafting and prosecution, post-grant proceedings such as oppositions, PGRs, or IPRs, and freedom-to-operate analyses.•    You have supported or led contract negotiations involving intellectual property, licensing, collaborations, or related commercial arrangements.•    You communicate complex intellectual property matters clearly to technical and non-technical audiences and build trusted relationships with diverse stakeholders.•    You take a collaborative, proactive, and strategic approach, work effectively in international cross-functional teams, and understand the regulatory frameworks for pharmaceutical products, medical devices, and digital health solutions. https://careers.merckgroup.com/fr/fr/apply?jobSeqNo=MQAMKDGLOBAL303054EXTERNALFRFR&step=1&stepname=personalInformation

jobs.title: Responsable d'applications cliniques Senior – Expertise technico-fonctionnelle
jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Responsable d'applications cliniques Senior – Expertise technico-fonctionnelle---Responsable d'applications cliniques Senior – Expertise technico\-fonctionnelle=================================================================================La Fédération des Hôpitaux Vaudois informatique ( ), est le partenaire informatique privilégié de plus de 12 Hôpitaux et établissements de santé régionaux du canton de Vaud. La FHVi les accompagne dans les nombreux défis de la transformation digitale du domaine de la santé et a pour principales missions de planifier, concevoir, réaliser et exploiter le SI de ses membres. Ce sont plus de 100 collaborateurs au service de 10'000 utilisateurs, pour parc de plus de 7'000 postes de travail répartis sur une centaine de sites géographiques et sur trois cantons (VD, VS, FR).Le poste s'adresse indifféremment à une femme ou à un homme. A des fins de commodité de lecture, les termes ne sont qu'au masculin. Responsable d'applications cliniques Senior – Expertise technico\-fonctionnelle=================================================================================Et si votre expertise technique et votre capacité à résoudre des problématiques complexes contribuaient directement à la performance des systèmes d'information hospitaliers ?Dans le cadre du renforcement de notre équipe en charge des systèmes d'information cliniques, nous recherchons un **Responsable d'applications Senior**, disposant d'une solide expertise technico\-fonctionnelle, d'une forte capacité d'analyse et d'une réelle autonomie dans la résolution de problématiques applicatives complexes.Ce poste s'adresse à un professionnel expérimenté qui aime comprendre le fonctionnement des applications dans leur globalité, investiguer les dysfonctionnements, identifier leurs causes profondes et proposer des solutions concrètes, fiables et adaptées aux besoins métier. **Votre mission :**En tant que Responsable d'applications Senior, vous assurez la responsabilité technique et fonctionnelle d'un portefeuille d'applications critiques du système d'information clinique, en garantissant leur disponibilité, leur performance, leur sécurité et leur évolution.Véritable référent technico\-fonctionnel, vous intervenez aussi bien sur la résolution d'incidents complexes que sur l'analyse des besoins métier, les évolutions applicatives et les études de faisabilité.Vous êtes capable de passer d'une problématique fonctionnelle à une investigation technique approfondie, puis à la définition et à la mise en œuvre d'une solution adaptée.Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les utilisateurs des établissements hospitaliers, les équipes informatiques internes et les fournisseurs de solutions.Votre rôle repose sur un équilibre entre expertise opérationnelle, compréhension métier, autonomie technique et capacité à prendre du recul sur les solutions proposées. **Vos principales activités et responsabilité :** **Gestion applicative et résolution d'incidents complexes*** Assurer le maintien en condition opérationnelle des applications de votre périmètre et garantir leur disponibilité, leur performance et leur fiabilité.  * Prendre en charge les incidents applicatifs complexes nécessitant une analyse approfondie des dimensions fonctionnelles et techniques.  * Investiguer les dysfonctionnements de manière autonome, identifier leurs causes profondes et mettre en œuvre des solutions correctives durables.  * Analyser les interactions et dépendances entre applications, bases de données, serveurs, interfaces et composants techniques.  * Exploiter les bases de données, notamment au travers de requêtes SQL avancées, pour analyser les anomalies et identifier les actions correctives.  * Réaliser les premières investigations techniques et solliciter les expertises spécialisées lorsque la situation le nécessite.  * Anticiper les risques liés aux évolutions technologiques, aux incompatibilités et à l'obsolescence des composants applicatifs.   **Expertise technique et intégration des systèmes*** Comprendre les architectures applicatives et les mécanismes d'intégration entre systèmes hétérogènes.  * Analyser les échanges de données, les interfaces et les webservices afin d'identifier et de résoudre les problèmes d'interopérabilité.  * Lire, comprendre et analyser du code existant, notamment en environnement C\#/.NET, afin de faciliter les investigations et les évolutions applicatives.  * Exploiter et adapter des scripts, notamment PowerShell, pour automatiser certaines opérations ou contribuer à la résolution de problèmes.  * Intervenir sur les problématiques liées aux environnements applicatifs Windows, aux bases de données et aux dépendances techniques.  * Collaborer avec les équipes de développement, d'infrastructure et d'interopérabilité pour assurer la cohérence et la maintenabilité des solutions.   **Évolution des applications et analyse des besoins métier*** Recueillir, analyser et challenger les besoins exprimés par les utilisateurs et les établissements hospitaliers.  * Comprendre les processus métier dans leur globalité et mesurer les impacts des évolutions sur les utilisateurs et les applications interconnectées.  * Traduire les besoins opérationnels en solutions fonctionnelles et techniques adaptées.  * Réaliser des analyses de faisabilité intégrant les contraintes techniques, les dépendances, les coûts, les délais et les risques.  * Proposer des solutions pragmatiques, proportionnées aux besoins et compatibles avec les ressources disponibles.  * Participer à la planification et à la réalisation des évolutions applicatives, des montées de version et des projets de transformation.  * Organiser les tests techniques et coordonner les validations fonctionnelles avant les mises en production.  * Contribuer à la gestion du cycle de vie des applications et à leur amélioration continue.   **Collaboration et accompagnement des utilisateurs*** Être un interlocuteur de référence pour les équipes métier, les équipes IT et les fournisseurs.  * Échanger avec des interlocuteurs variés, notamment les professionnels de santé, les équipes administratives et les responsables informatiques des établissements.  * Vulgariser les problématiques techniques et expliquer clairement les impacts des différentes options envisagées.  * Challenger de manière constructive les demandes métier et les propositions des fournisseurs.  * Accompagner les utilisateurs dans l'évolution de leurs pratiques et l'optimisation des solutions applicatives.  * Documenter les analyses, les interventions et les solutions mises en œuvre afin de favoriser le partage des connaissances et la continuité de service.   **Profil recherché** : **Formation et expérience*** Formation supérieure en informatique (HES, EPF, université ou formation jugée équivalente).  * Expérience professionnelle confirmée, idéalement d'au moins 8 à 10 ans, dans la gestion et l'évolution d'applications métier complexes.  * Parcours significatif en tant que Responsable applicatif, Product Owner, expert technico\-fonctionnel ou dans une fonction équivalente impliquant une forte responsabilité opérationnelle et technique.  * Expérience démontrée dans la résolution autonome d'incidents complexes et la gestion du cycle de vie d'applications critiques.  * Expérience dans un environnement informatique complexe, impliquant de multiples applications, interfaces, technologies et interlocuteurs.  Une expérience initiale en développement logiciel, complétée par une évolution vers la gestion applicative, constitue un parcours particulièrement intéressant. **Compétences techniques***  **Maîtrise avancée de SQL**, notamment pour les requêtes complexes, l'analyse et la manipulation de données, l'investigation d'incidents et la compréhension des procédures stockées.  * Bonne compréhension du développement applicatif, particulièrement en environnement **C\#/.NET**, avec la capacité de lire et d'analyser du code existant.  * Connaissances opérationnelles en **PowerShell et scripting**, permettant de comprendre, d'adapter ou d'automatiser certaines opérations.  * Solide compréhension des architectures applicatives, des **webservices, API et mécanismes d'intégration** entre applications.  * Bonne connaissance des environnements Windows et des interactions entre applications, serveurs, bases de données et composants techniques.  * Capacité à analyser les impacts techniques et fonctionnels des évolutions, des changements de version et des problèmes de compatibilité.  * Sensibilité aux enjeux de sécurité, de disponibilité, de performance et de continuité des services.   **Compétences professionnelles et qualités personnelles** Au\-delà des compétences techniques, nous recherchons avant tout un professionnel qui se distingue par :*  **Une excellente capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes complexes :** vous savez investiguer méthodiquement, identifier les causes profondes d'un dysfonctionnement et proposer des solutions pertinentes.  *  **Une forte autonomie :** vous êtes capable de prendre en charge une problématique de bout en bout, de rechercher les informations nécessaires et de mobiliser les bonnes ressources.  *  **Un réel pragmatisme :** vous savez arbitrer entre les différentes solutions possibles en tenant compte de leur valeur ajoutée, de leur coût, des délais, des risques et de leur maintenabilité.  *  **Une vision transverse :** vous comprenez les interactions entre les dimensions métier, fonctionnelles et techniques d'un système d'information.  *  **Une grande polyvalence et une forte capacité d'adaptation :** vous êtes à l'aise dans des environnements variés et savez passer rapidement d'une problématique à une autre, tout en gérant les priorités.  *  **Un excellent relationnel :**

Vous souhaitez participer activement à la transition énergétique en apportant à nos clients des solutions renouvelables et innovantes ? **Chef de projet installations électriques 80\-100% (H/F)**Orientation service après\-vente et petites installations   **VOTRE MISSION** En tant que Chef de projet, vous assurez la gestion technique, financière et administrative des projets liés principalement au service après\-vente, aux dépannages et aux petites installations électriques. Vous coordonnez les ressources et accompagnez les équipes tout en garantissant la satisfaction des clients et la rentabilité des affaires. **VOS RESPONSABILITES PRINCIPALES** * **Gestion de projets :** planifier et coordonner les chantiers sous votre responsabilité.* **Suivi financier et administratif :** établir les offres et métrés, contrôler les coûts et les heures, assurer la facturation et le suivi des affaires.* **Organisation et encadrement :** planifier les ressources, gérer les commandes et le matériel, accompagner les monteurs et apprentis.* **Service après\-vente et clientèle :** traiter les demandes, organiser les interventions, développer les prestations et fidéliser la clientèle.* **Sécurité et conformité :** garantir le respect des normes OIBT et NIBT, des prescriptions de sécurité et assurer le suivi des contrôles et avis officiels. **VOTRE PROFIL** * CFC d'installateur\-électricien, complété par un brevet fédéral de chef de projet, de conseiller en sécurité électrique ou une maîtrise fédérale, ou formation jugée équivalente.* Minimum 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction similaire, avec conduite d'équipe et gestion de chantiers.* Solides connaissances techniques en installations électriques, ainsi qu'en gestion de projets et suivi financier.* Bonne maîtrise des normes électriques et des outils informatiques.* Langue maternelle française ; allemand, un atout.* Personnalité autonome, organisée et proactive, dotée d'un bon esprit d'analyse, d'un sens aigu du service et de bonnes aptitudes relationnelles. **CE QUE NOUS VOUS OFFRONS*** Un poste varié et stimulant, au cœur des activités électriques de notre région.* Une fonction autonome avec des responsabilités et une réelle proximité avec la clientèle.* Un environnement de travail dynamique, au sein d'une équipe de professionnels engagés.* La possibilité de mettre à profit vos compétences techniques, organisationnelles et commerciales.* Un cadre de travail moderne* Et bien plus ici : Des renseignements complémentaires peuvent être obtenus auprès du Capital Humain au \+![Gruyère Energie S.A.]()* Gruyère Energie S.A.  Rue de l'Etang 20  1630 Bulle*jidd4be31cjm jit1145jm jiy26jm

jobs.title: Key Account Supply Chain Manager
jobs.description: **Purpose of the role**  *  As a Key Account Supply Chain Manager, you will be a customer-facing supply chain expert responsible for managing relationships with assigned key accounts and supporting global account strategies.  *  You will work in a dynamic, global environment requiring strong analytical skills, agility, and a proactive mindset to drive customer satisfaction.**Responsibilities**  *  Act as the main point of contact for customers on operational supply chain topics  *  Ensure execution of defined supply chain strategies across all product lines  *  Support the Global Account Supply Chain Manager (GASCM) with analysis, scenario modeling, and business reviews  *  Create, manage, and analyze KPIs (e.g., On-Time Delivery, Lead Time, Inventory, Forecast Accuracy)  *  Provide performance insights and track improvement actions  *  Monitor supply chain performance via control tower tools to identify risks and opportunities  *  Orchestrate internal supply chain functions (planning, logistics, operations) to meet customer needs  *  Manage and execute supply chain agreements (e.g., consignment, stocking programs)  *  Act as the first point of escalation for operational supply chain issues**Qualifications:**  *  Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or similar  *  3–5 years of experience in supply chain, demand planning, or customer service within a global organization (high-tech or semiconductor industry preferred)  *  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with proven execution capability  *  Advanced Excel skills (mandatory) and experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI)  *  Experience with ERP systems, preferably MS Dynamics 365 (F&amp;O)  *  Solid understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes  *  Excellent communication and collaboration skills in an international environment  *  Highly customer-focused, proactive, and detail-oriented  *  Fluent in English; German is a strong advantage

jobs.title: Front Office Agent 100 % (w/m/i)
jobs.description: Eine Ikone der Schweizer Hotellerie und eine Legende seit der sensationellen Eröffnung im Jahr 1873. Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft.Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel & Alpine Spa (5 Sterne Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5 Sterne Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3 Sterne) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur.Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz – eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit Stolz erfüllt.Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarungeine/n Front Office Agent 100 % (w/m/i) Aufgaben: - Durchführen von Check-In/Check-Out unter Einhaltung der LQA Standards- Anreisevorbereitung auf täglicher Basis- Bearbeiten von täglichen Checklisten der Rezeption- Verkauf von Hotelgutscheinen- Erfassen von Reservationen für Zimmer und Restaurants am Desk- aktiver Zusatzverkauf [mit attraktiver Gewinnbeteiligung]- Vorbeugen und Handeln von Gästebeschwerden in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Senior Leadership Team des Front Office- Annahme von In Room Dining Bestellungen- Annahme und Koordination von diversen Gästeanfragen- Arbeiten im Früh-/Mittel-/Spätdienst mit einzelnen Einsätzen im NachtdienstSie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im administrativen Bereich. - Idealerweise bringen Sie bereits Erfahrungen im Tourismus oder in der Hotellerie mit. Deutsch, Englisch und vorzugsweise auch Französisch beherrschen Sie fliessend in Wort und Schrift. - Schicht- und Wochenendarbeiten sind für Sie selbstverständlich. Sie zeigen hohe Leistungsbereitschaft, sind sehr flexibel und belastbar und arbeiten auch unter Zeit- und Arbeitsdruck ruhig, exakt und effizient. Neben einem modernen Arbeitsplatz profitieren Sie von zahlreichen attraktiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und Vergünstigungen. Das Personalhaus verfügt über ein eigenes Fitnessstudio, eine TV-Lounge, einen Billardraum sowie eine Bibliothek. Darüber hinaus geniessen Sie Ermässigungen in unseren Restaurants sowie Vorzugskonditionen für Sie, Ihre Familie und Freunde für Übernachtungen in unseren Hotels. Weitere Vorteile umfassen Vergünstigungen für Tennis, Golf, Sportartikel, Versicherungen, Gruppenkurse und REKA-Checks.Auch Ihre Mobilität unterstützen wir: Die Anreise mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln wird finanziell gefördert, und Parkplätze stehen zu attraktiven Konditionen zur Verfügung.Wir investieren in Ihre Zukunft: Mit Zugang zur Beekeeper-Mitarbeiterapp, vielfältigen Weiterbildungsangeboten, internen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und erstklassigen Karriereperspektiven schaffen wir den Rahmen für Ihre persönliche und berufliche Entfaltung.Sie erwartet die Chance, Teil eines Weltklasse-Resorts zu sein, aktiv zum gemeinsamen Erfolg beizutragen und sich in einem inspirierenden Umfeld kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Motivationsschreiben, Arbeitszeugnissen und Foto.Auszeichnungen:Swiss Location Awards «Switzerland's Best Meeting Location»World Spa Awards Switzerland’s Best Hotel Spa 2025LHW Membership Awards Sustainability LeaderGreat Place To Work 2025The New York Times’52 Places to Go in 2018Travel + Leisure 500 List 2021Handelszeitung Bester Arbeitgeber im Hospitality Sektor 2023 Connoisseur Circle Best Gourmet HotelMICHELIN Wellness Award Best Wellness HotelGALA Spa Awards Best Spa ConceptMICHELIN Keys 3/3 Keys

jobs.title: Technical Supplier Manager
jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Technical Supplier Manager--- Technical Supplier Manager==========================Switzerland bridges the gap between pharmaceuticals and diagnostics. Important research and development functions are based here. For our long\-standing client, Diagnostics International AG in Rotkreuz, we are looking for a:**Technical Supplier Manager**==============================At Diagnostics, we develop and deliver life\-critical diagnostic solutions that support healthcare professionals and patients worldwide.As part of the Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT) organization within the Global Instrument Network (GIN), you will play a key role in ensuring robust manufacturing processes, reliable supplier performance, and long\-term supply security.You will act as the technical interface between internal engineering and operations teams and international contract manufacturing partners. Your responsibilities include technical ownership of instrument components, subassemblies, and production lines, with a strong focus on manufacturing process design, validation, and industrialization.You will also lead external\-to\-external (E2E) technology transfers, second\-sourcing initiatives, and capacity expansions to ensure consistent product quality and reliable supply.**Your Responsibilities**### *Manufacturing Process Design \& Industrialization** Design, develop, optimize, and industrialize manufacturing and testing processes for instrument components, electronics, and precision assemblies across external supplier sites.* Define and implement process validation strategies (IQ/OQ/PQ), design verification protocols, and process capability assessments, including Cp/Cpk, tolerance studies, and Gage R\&R.* Collaborate with R\&D during early product development to integrate Design for Manufacturing, Assembly, and Testability (DfX) principles, improve yields, and prevent manufacturing bottlenecks.* Identify and mitigate manufacturing risks through pFMEA, poka\-yoke (error\-proofing), and structured root\-cause investigations.### *Technical Project Leadership \& Technology Transfers** Lead external\-to\-external (E2E) technology transfers between contract manufacturers and suppliers, including production line relocations, tool duplications, and second\-source qualifications.* Develop qualification master plans (QMPs), coordinate project schedules and milestones, and provide transparent progress reporting to MSAT and GIN leadership.* Ensure technical alignment and effective change control between transferring and receiving supplier sites, Global Sourcing, Quality Assurance, and Regulatory Affairs.### *Technical Supplier Management \& Operations Support** Monitor supplier manufacturing processes, technical KPIs, process stability, and component quality throughout the instrument lifecycle.* Lead technical investigations and sustainable corrective actions for component deviations and Supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCARs), using methods such as 8D, Ishikawa, and 5\-Why.* Conduct technical supplier assessments and audits to support the qualification of new and existing manufacturing partners.* Manage supplier\-side engineering changes without specification changes, capacity expansions, and continuous production line stabilization initiatives.*  **Your Profile**### *Education \& Professional Experience** University degree (Bachelor's or Master's) or Higher Technical Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Process Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline.* At least 5–6 years of relevant industry experience in manufacturing process design, technical supplier management, industrialization, or manufacturing engineering, ideally within medical devices, in\-vitro diagnostics (IVD), pharmaceuticals, or precision high\-tech equipment.### *Technical Expertise** Proven hands\-on experience in designing, qualifying, and optimizing manufacturing and testing processes.* Strong knowledge of statistical process control (SPC), process capability studies (Cp/Cpk), measurement systems analysis (MSA), and pFMEA.* Solid understanding of precision manufacturing technologies, such as injection molding, precision mechanics and machining, electronics assembly, and automated testing.* Understanding of manufacturing cost drivers and cycle time optimization.* Practical knowledge of ISO 13485, GMP/FDA regulations, process validation (IQ/OQ/PQ), and formal change management procedures.### *Project Management \& Collaboration** Demonstrated experience leading complex technical projects, particularly external\-to\-external technology transfers, second\-sourcing initiatives, or major production line ramp\-ups.* A project management certification (PMP, IPMA, Agile) is an advantage.* Pragmatic and jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Group AI Transformation Lead 100%---Group AI Transformation Lead 100%================================= Founded in 1968, **SKAN** is a pioneer in cleanroom equipment and the development of isolators for the pharmaceutical industry. Innovative products, tailor\-made solutions and an effective service organization have made SKAN a market leader and a key partner to industry and research laboratories. Now, we are opening the next chapter by making AI an everyday tool \- for our customers as well as our 1,700 foundations are in place: Our AI policy has been approved, and initial applications are already up and running. Now, we are looking for you: someone who can identify the right opportunities, bring people along on the journey, and ensure that ideas translate into measurable value. You will report directly to our Group CFO, build a small interdisciplinary team, and have significant freedom to shape this transformation \- guided by the principle: "Centralize the foundation. Federate the value creation." Your workplace will be our headquarters in Allschwil, in the canton of Basel\-Landschaft, Switzerland.  **Responsibilities** * You develop the Group\-wide AI roadmap and manage a prioritized portfolio of initiatives based on business value, customer value, feasibility, and risk.* Together with the business functions, you identify where AI can make the greatest difference in processes, products, and services.* You lead selected flagship projects from initial idea and business case through to production deployment \- and measure their success.* You scale what works and consistently discontinue initiatives that fail to deliver added value.* In collaboration with ICT, you drive the broad and secure adoption of Group\-approved AI tools and bring AI agents and automated workflows to the areas where they can deliver meaningful impact.* You build a network of AI Champions and Power Users and embed AI into SKAN's existing Operating Model.* You bring Business, ICT, Security, Quality, Legal, HR, and Finance together and ensure transparency around usage, value, costs, and risks \- providing the basis for informed Executive Management decisions.   **Hardskills*** A completed degree in Computer Science, Business Information Systems, Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable qualification.* Several years of experience in digital or business transformation, with a proven track record of leading initiatives from strategy through production deployment and scaling.* A solid understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models, and AI agents \- as well as what it takes to ensure AI operates securely and at scale within an organization: integration, data, access permissions, and security.* You evaluate AI initiatives based on business value, feasibility, and risk, and manage them through business cases and measurable outcomes.* Experience leading cross\-functional initiatives and managing stakeholders up to Executive Management level.* Experience in industry, engineering, pharmaceuticals, or life sciences, or in regulated environments, is a plus.* Excellent English skills; language skills are an advantage.   **Softskills** * You inspire confidence through your personality \- whether engaging with Executive Management, engineers, or specialists.* You think strategically and are equally willing to roll up your sleeves and get things done.* You distill complexity into what really matters and provide clear recommendations.* You bring people together across functional boundaries, even without direct line management responsibility.* You challenge the status quo with confidence and work collaboratively without getting caught up in consensus for its own sake.* You are curious and a fast learner \- while remaining focused on facts and measurable value rather than being driven by hype.  **We offer you*** A Group\-wide mission to shape and drive AI transformation, with a direct reporting line to the Group CFO* The opportunity to make AI impactful in an area that contributes to the safe manufacturing of pharmaceuticals and vaccines* An open and collaborative corporate culture* Freedom to develop and implement your ideas* Access to sports and recreational activities* Opportunities for professional development, particularly through our SKAN Academy* Comprehensive, job\-focused onboarding* Short decision\-making processes and a flat organizational structure* Open and transparent communication* Five weeks of vacation, with the option to purchase additional vacation days  **Additional information**  We look forward to receiving your complete application documents (CV, diplomas and employment references) via our career page.  For this position, we are focusing on direct applications and are not working with external agencies. Head of Creative – Responsable Création Publicitaire Digitale (H/F)
======================================================================

Qui sommes\-nous ?
------------------

REA E\-Commerce est une entreprise suisse spécialisée dans le e\-commerce, propriétaire de la marque **Der Gute Fund**, qui commercialise des produits innovants pour la maison sur le marché allemand.

Notre croissance repose principalement sur la publicité digitale, notamment Meta Ads (Facebook et Instagram).

Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons un(e) **Head of Creative** pour structurer et piloter notre pôle de création publicitaire, avec pour objectif de produire des publicités toujours plus performantes.

 

Votre mission
-------------

Votre mission principale sera de concevoir et mettre en place une organisation de production publicitaire efficace, structurée et évolutive.

Vous prendrez la responsabilité du pôle Création, avec pour objectif d'optimiser l'ensemble du processus, de la recherche d'idées publicitaires jusqu'à la livraison et à l'analyse des contenus.

Vous devrez combiner une solide compréhension de la publicité digitale avec d'excellentes compétences en organisation, en gestion de projets et en optimisation des processus.

 

Vos responsabilités
--------------------

### 1\. Structuration et optimisation des processus

* Concevoir, documenter et améliorer les processus de création publicitaire.
* Structurer le flux de production, de la recherche publicitaire jusqu'à la livraison des contenus.
* Mettre en place des méthodes de travail claires, standardisées et reproductibles.
* Développer des systèmes de gestion de projets, de planification et de suivi de production.
* Créer des modèles de briefs, des procédures et des standards de qualité.
* Identifier les inefficacités et mettre en place des solutions pour améliorer la productivité.
* Construire une organisation capable d'accompagner la croissance de l'entreprise et de l'équipe.


 

### 2\. Stratégie et création publicitaire digitale

* Définir et développer la stratégie créative de nos campagnes publicitaires.
* Rechercher et analyser les publicités performantes, les tendances et les opportunités créatives.
* Développer de nouveaux concepts, angles marketing, hooks et scripts publicitaires.
* Transformer les idées publicitaires en briefs précis et exploitables par l'équipe de production.
* Superviser la création de publicités vidéo, notamment les démonstrations produits et les contenus UGC.
* Analyser les performances des publicités afin d'identifier les concepts gagnants.
* Mettre en place des méthodes de tests et d'itérations pour améliorer continuellement les performances créatives.
* Utiliser les données publicitaires pour orienter les prochaines productions.


 

### 3\. Pilotage des projets et coordination de l'équipe

* Planifier, organiser et superviser les différents projets de création.
* Définir les priorités, les échéances et les livrables attendus.
* Coordonner les collaborateurs internes et les créateurs de contenus externes.
* Assurer le suivi des projets et le respect des délais.
* Contrôler la qualité des contenus produits.
* Accompagner les collaborateurs dans l'application des processus et des méthodes de travail.
* Participer au développement de l'équipe en collaboration avec la direction.


 

Votre profil
------------

### Expérience et compétences professionnelles

* Expérience confirmée en création de publicités digitales, idéalement dans le e\-commerce ou le performance marketing.
* Excellente maîtrise de Meta Ads et des stratégies créatives orientées conversion.
* Expérience dans la création et l'optimisation de processus de production publicitaire.
* Solides compétences en gestion de projets, organisation et coordination d'équipes créatives.
* Capacité à analyser les performances publicitaires pour orienter la stratégie créative.
* Bonne maîtrise des formats vidéo publicitaires (UGC, démonstrations produits, hooks) et des étapes de production, du script au montage.
* Maîtrise des outils de gestion de projets et de collaboration.


### Qualités personnelles

* Vous êtes particulièrement structuré(e), méthodique et organisé(e).
* Vous aimez construire des systèmes, améliorer les méthodes de travail et résoudre les problèmes.
* Vous êtes autonome, proactif(ve) et capable de prendre des initiatives.
* Vous possédez un esprit analytique et une forte orientation vers les résultats.
* Vous savez transformer des objectifs en plans d'action concrets.
* Vous êtes à l'aise dans un environnement entrepreneurial en évolution.
* Vous combinez créativité, rigueur et sens des priorités.


### Ce que nous offrons

* La possibilité de prendre la responsabilité d'un pôle stratégique de notre entreprise.
* Une grande autonomie pour concevoir et mettre en place vos propres méthodes de travail.
* L'opportunité de construire des processus et une organisation durables.
* Des projets publicitaires variés, avec un impact direct sur les performances commerciales.
* Un environnement entrepreneurial dynamique, avec des décisions rapides et peu de niveaux hiérarchiques.
* La possibilité de développer progressivement le pôle Création publicitaire.
* Une collaboration directe avec la direction.


 

### Entrée en fonction : Dès que possible ou à convenir.

jobs.title: Associate Philanthropy Advisor – Private Major Donors
jobs.description: **Join MSF OCG as a Associate Philanthropy Advisor – Private Major Donors!****We are looking for passionate candidates ready to contribute to our humanitarian mission.****Below, you will find the job details and the qualifications we are looking for.**Inclusivity and Diversity at MSFDo your qualifications and experience not exactly match all requirements of the job?At MSF OCG, we are committed to an inclusive culture that supports and amplifies the diverse voices of our staff members. We strive to create workplaces where teams of people with diverse backgrounds, characteristics, perspectives, ideas and experiences work together to advance MSF's social mission and create better outcomes for our patients and the communities we work with.We understand that some people may hesitate to apply for employment if they don't meet all listed job requirements. Research shows that this is especially true for women. If you believe your profile is a good match for this position, we invite you to apply even if you don’t fulfil every listed qualification.We encourage applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, ethnicities, background, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.MSF does not tolerate sexual exploitation and abuse, any kind of discrimination or harassment, including sexual harassment. All selected candidates will undergo reference checks.Context \& missionMédecins Sans Frontières is an independent, international medical and humanitarian organization that provides care to people in need, people affected by natural or man\-made disasters, and victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and without regard to race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter).The MSF movement is built around 5 operational centers supported by 24 sections and offices worldwide. MSF Operational Center Geneva (MSF OCG) is one of these centers.MSF Switzerland was created in 1981 and it is headquartered in Geneva. The Philanthropy Unit is one of the eight units at the Communications and Fundraising Department. To ensure a good geographical coverage of the Swiss fundraising market, the Unit is divided into two offices: Geneva and Zurich. The Unit’s mission is to strengthen MSF’s relationship with its private major supporters, including wealthy individuals, foundations, companies, and other philanthropic organisations. It also manages grants and donations from Swiss cantons and communes. Last but not least, it is also in charge of legacy fundraising, including management of heritages as well as contacts with potential legators and confirmed bequestors.The Associate Philanthropy Advisor for private major donors in German speaking Switzerland is a key member of the Philanthropy Unit, ensuring an efficient and effective cultivation approach for private major donors in German speaking Switzerland and Liechtenstein. The mission is to secure and grow income for MSF from private major donors in German speaking Switzerland.Tasks \& Responsibilities*Strategy and action plan*Actively contribute to the implementation of the yearly plan*Cultivation and stewardship*Manages a portfolio of Major Donors and potential Top Major Donors and, alongside the Team Coordinator, design and develop the donor journey for donors giving between CHF 10’000 and CHF 20’000 annually.Regularly reports to and consults with the Team Coordinator on the strategy for the pool regarding upgrading donors within this segment.Determine the best approach and journey for each individual donor depending on their wishes and level of engagement.Prepare and facilitate one\-to\-one meetings, calls, presentations and other meaningful interactions with major donors.Interact and collaborate with key spokespersons within MSF (President, General Director, Director of Operations, other management team members), as well as field staff, with the aim of bringing donors closer to the organisation to demonstrate our life\-saving mission and work in the , propose and organise visits to MSF offices and projects, in line with MSF criteria and that the nature / identity of donors is in line with MSF gifts acceptance that the donor journey runs smoothly, and donors are thanked and stewarded the database is kept engaging communication for the MDs about MSF projects.*Solicitation/ask*In line with the yearly plan and past giving history of main donors, proactively present asks to selected donors for gifts (general and individualized asks) and consult with the Team Coordinator about the solicitation planEnsure that the major donors journey strategy is followed and that major donors are solicited according to their motivations in a personalised way.

jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Kinderbetreuer/-in 100% (w/m/i)---Kinderbetreuer/\-in 100% (w/m/i)================================unbefristetKinderbetreuer/\-in 100% (w/m/i)================================unbefristet  Eine Ikone der Schweizer Hotellerie und eine Legende seit der sensationellen Eröffnung im Jahr 1873\. Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft.    Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel \& Alpine Spa (5\* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5\* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3\*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur.    Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz \- eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit erfüllt.    Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab Januar 2027 oder nach Vereinbarung eine/n  * Sie führen selbständig die Kinderbetreuung auf dem Bürgenstock und gestalten für unsere kleinen Gäste aus der ganzen Welt ein spannendes Programm* Sie organisieren und planen die Aktivitäten individuell nach den Wünschen der Eltern und Kindern* Beraten und Informieren über unsere Kids Club Dienstleistungen und Angebote* Betreuung und Animation der Kinder und Jugendlichen* Abwicklung und Dokumentation der Gästebetreuung* Vorbereitung und Mithilfe des wöchentlichen abwechslungsreichen Programm* Aufräumen und Reinigen der Räumlichkeiten sowie die aktive Mithilfe im Alpine SpaSie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachfrau/\-mann Betreuung EFZ oder haben mindestens 3\-4 Jahre Erfahrung als Kinderbetreuerin in Kindertagesstätten oder ähnlichen Einrichtungen. An Wochenenden und Feiertagen unterhalten Sie die Kinder im Kids Club genauso wie an allen Wochentagen und sind flexible die Wünsche unseren kleinen Gästen in deren Eltern nachzukommen. Ein hohes Mass an Verantwortung, Interesse an Musik und Tanz sowie Deutsch, Englisch und allenfalls weitere Sprachkenntnisse qualifizieren Sie ebenso für diese spannende Position, wie die Freude mit Kindern zu arbeiten.  Neben einem modernen Arbeitsplatz profitieren Sie von zahlreichen attraktiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und Vergünstigungen. Das Personalhaus verfügt über ein eigenes Fitnessstudio, eine TV\-Lounge, einen Billardraum sowie eine Bibliothek. Darüber hinaus geniessen Sie Ermässigungen in unseren Restaurants sowie Vorzugskonditionen für Sie, Ihre Familie und Freunde für Übernachtungen in unseren Hotels. Weitere Vorteile umfassen Vergünstigungen für Tennis, Golf, Sportartikel, Versicherungen, Gruppenkurse und REKA\-Checks.    Auch Ihre Mobilität unterstützen wir: Die Anreise mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln wird finanziell gefördert, und Parkplätze stehen zu attraktiven Konditionen zur Verfügung.    Wir investieren in Ihre Zukunft: Mit Zugang zur Beekeeper\-Mitarbeiterapp, vielfältigen Weiterbildungsangeboten, internen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und erstklassigen Karriereperspektiven schaffen wir den Rahmen für Ihre persönliche und berufliche Entfaltung.    Sie erwartet die Chance, Teil eines Weltklasse\-Resorts zu sein, aktiv zum gemeinsamen Erfolg beizutragen und sich in einem inspirierenden Umfeld kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.    Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Motivationsschreiben, Arbeitszeugnissen und Foto.     Auszeichnungen:   *Swiss Location Awards «Switzerland's Best Meeting Location»  World Spa Awards «Switzerland's Best Hotel Spa 2025»  LHW Membership Awards «Sustainability Leader»  Great Place To Work 2025  The New York Times'«52 Places to Go in 2018»  Travel \+ Leisure «500 List 2021»  Handelszeitung «Bester Arbeitgeber im Hospitality Sektor 2023»Connoisseur Circle «Best Gourmet Hotel*»*  MICHELIN Wellness Award «Best Wellness Hotel»  GALA Spa Awards «Best Spa Concept»  MICHELIN Keys «3/3 Keys»       BÜRGENSTOCK HOTELS AG  Koch  HR Assistant  Bürgenstock 30  6363 Obbürgen  Telefon*    ******jid6a6f92ejm jit1145jm jiy26jm

jobs.title: Tysklærer søges til virksomhedsrettet undervisningsforløb - Herning
jobs.description:
Vi søger en underviser til Tysk i et virksomhedsrettet undervisningsforløb tæt på Herning.

Det er 2 forløb for medarbejdere, som ønsker enten at genopfriske deres tyskkundskaber eller opnå større tryghed i at anvende tysk på et grundlæggende niveau.

Behovet for kommunikation opstår både i forbindelse med telefonisk kontakt med tyske kunder og ved arbejde på deres tyske sites.

Målgruppen er både begyndere eller medarbejdere som ikke har anvendt tysk siden skoletiden og medarbejdere som er letøvede der ønsker at forbedre deres nuværende tyskkundskaber.

Kurserne afholdes på en virksomhed tæt ved Herning - gerne i dagtimerne mandag.

Der aflønnes efter folkeoplysningens løncirkulære pr. lekt. kr. 330,74 + feriepenge 12,5% i alt kr. 372,08

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig eller en du kender.

 

Bh LOF Midtjylland

jobs.title: Quality Laboratory Coordinator
jobs.description: BAT is evolving at pace into a global multi-category business. Our purpose is to create A Better Tomorrow™ by Building a Smokeless World.To achieve our ambition, we are looking for colleagues who are ready to join us on this journey! Tomorrow can’t wait, let’s shape it together!British American Tobacco Sweden has an exciting opportunity for a Quality Laboratory Coordinator in Malmö.The Quality Laboratory Coordinator leads and oversees the day-to-day operations of the factory Quality Laboratory, ensuring accurate, reliable, and timely testing of raw materials, in-process samples, and finished products in compliance with BAT Quality standards, legal requirements, and regulatory expectations.As the laboratory's technical lead, the role drives excellence through robust analytical practices, equipment reliability, data integrity, and capability development. The Quality Laboratory Coordinator supports factory decision-making through accurate quality data, ensures laboratory compliance, and drives continuous improvement across laboratory operations and performance.Your key responsibilities will include:    Lead, coach, and develop a team of 6-8 laboratory professionals, ensuring strong technical capability, engagement, and performance.    Manage day-to-day laboratory operations to ensure timely testing and release of raw materials, in-process samples, and finished products.    Ensure the accuracy, reliability, integrity, and timely delivery of all laboratory testing results.    Maintain compliance with BAT Quality standards, GMP, HACCP, local regulatory requirements, and applicable quality management systems.    Own and maintain laboratory systems, including SOPs, test methods, equipment calibration, validation activities, and documentation control.    Ensure data integrity, traceability, and proper documentation of all laboratory activities, testing records, and quality results.    Lead investigations into quality issues, OOS (Out of Specification) results, and laboratory deviations, implementing effective RCA and CAPA actions.    Support factory performance through quality data analysis, reporting, NCP coordination, New Product Introduction (NPI) activities, and IWS Quality Pillar initiatives.    Comply and implement activities in accordance with the rules of laws and regulations relating to environmental protection, safety at work and fire protection, and internal EHS or Sustainability standards and procedures. What are we looking for?    2-4+ years of experience in Quality Control laboratory operations within a manufacturing environment.    Previous experience leading teams and coordinating laboratory workloads in a fast-paced operational setting.    Experience managing OOS investigations, quality deviations, audit preparation, and regulatory inspections.    Proven experience in laboratory method validation, equipment qualification, calibration programs, and quality system management.    Strong knowledge of analytical testing techniques, including physical, chemical, and/or microbiological analysis.    Solid understanding of GMP, HACCP, ISO standards, laboratory compliance requirements, and data integrity principles.    Proficiency in Root Cause Analysis (RCA), CAPA management, structured problem-solving methodologies, sampling plans, and statistical quality tools.    Technical qualification or degree in a scientific or technical discipline, with GMP, HACCP, or Laboratory Quality certification required; ISO 17025 and Lean Six Sigma Green Belt knowledge or certification preferred.What we offer you?    We offer a market leading annual performance bonus (subject to eligibility)    Our range of benefits varies by country and includes diverse health plans, initiatives for work-life balance, transportation support, and a flexible holiday plan with additional incentives    Your journey with us isn't limited by boundaries; it's propelled by your aspirations. Join us at BAT and become a part of an environment that thrives on internal advancement, where your career progression isn't just a statement – it's a reality we're eager to build together. Seize the opportunity and own your development; your next chapter starts here.    You'll have access to online learning platforms and personalized growth programs to nurture your leadership skills    We prioritise continuous improvement within a transformative environment, preparing for ongoing changesWHY JOIN BAT?In BAT Sweden we strive to create a smokeless reality on a day-to-day basis. If you wonder how we are getting there, please take a look at the OMNI report – a comprehensive study done to analyse the current market trends in tobacco harm reduction.We're one of the few companies named as a Global Top Employer by the Top Employers Institute – certified in offering excellent employee conditions.Collaboration, inclusion and partnership underpin everything we do here at BAT. We are looking forward to enabling every individual to thrive, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, skills, experience, education, socio-economic and professional background, veteran status, perspectives and thinking styles. We know that embracing talent from all backgrounds is what makes us stronger and best prepared to meet our business goals.We see the career breaks as opportunities, not obstacles. Through The Global Returners program, we support professionals looking to restart their careers after an extended absence from the workforce (e.g. time out caring for family, parental leave, national service, sabbatical and/or starting an own venture).Come bring your difference and see what is possible for you at BAT. Learn more about our culture and our award winning employee experience here.If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations to help you perform at your best during the recruitment process, you are encouraged to notify us. We are fully committed to support you by making appropriate arrangements for you to demonstrate your full potential.

What matters most is your understanding of commercial vehicles and the motivation to develop within a growing business.Your responsibilitiesAs Product Manager, you will be part of MEKO's Commercial Vehicle Division and work closely with the Danish FTZ Truck & Trailer organization.You will support the development of several product groups within Heavy Commercial Vehicles, helping ensure the right assortment, pricing and product information are available to meet customer needs and commercial objectives.Your responsibilities will include:•    Identifying and supporting new product launches and assortment development initiatives.•    Preparing sourcing requirements and request-for-quotation material, as well as evaluating products together with colleagues in other MEKO markets.•    Coordinating product introductions, replacements and phase-outs.•    Managing product data and maintaining information in catalogues and PIM systems.•    Monitoring competitor offerings and contributing to pricing and assortment decisions.•    Following up on product performance, price levels, returns, obsolescence and opportunities for assortment improvements.•    Providing technical product knowledge and supporting the sales organization in product-related matters.•    Working with suppliers, category management, logistics and other internal stakeholders to maintain a competitive product offering.The position combines day-to-day operational responsibilities with opportunities to participate in broader commercial and category management activities.You will work closely with the local Head of Commercial Vehicles in Denmark and colleagues within the wider MEKO CV organization. Strategic category direction and additional support are provided by the responsible Group Category Manager.This is an individual contributor role without personnel responsibility.Din ProfilYour profileWe are primarily looking for someone who understands the technical and practical side of the heavy commercial vehicle industry.You might currently be working as a Spare Parts Specialist, Parts Manager, Technical Sales Representative, Product Specialist, Workshop Coordinator or Product Manager. Your current title is less important than your experience and knowledge.A background from truck and trailer workshops, spare parts distribution, fleet maintenance, agricultural machinery, construction equipment or other heavy-duty applications may be relevant.We believe you bring:•    Strong knowledge of commercial vehicles, components, spare parts and their applications.•    Relevant experience from heavy commercial vehicles (truck, trailer, bus) or comparable heavy-duty applications – e.g. from workshop, spare parts, technical sales or product work.•    Good computer skills and the ability to work in a structured way with product information.•    An interest in developing analytical, commercial and product management skills.•    Initiative, curiosity and the ability to work independently while collaborating with others.•    Good communication skills and fluency in English, both written and spoken.It is advantageous if you also have:•    Previous experience in product management, assortment development or technical purchasing.•    Experience with Excel, ERP or PIM systems.•    Experience analyzing product information, sales data or market developments.•    Danish language skills or knowledge of other Nordic languages.•    A post-secondary technical education.Your understanding of trucks, trailers and heavy-duty components, combined with your motivation and willingness to learn, will be central to your success.Om företagetAbout MEKOMEKO is Northern Europe's largest player in the automotive aftermarket, with approximately 600 stores, 20,000 workshop customers and 4,600 workshops across eight countries, operating through strong brands such as Mekonomen, MECA and FTZ.The Group drives development in digitalization, AI and logistics, offering smart and sustainable solutions for vehicle service and spare parts. MEKO's vision is to enable mobility – today, tomorrow and in the future.In Denmark, MEKO operates through FTZ, a well-established name in the Danish automotive aftermarket. The Commercial Vehicle Division is an expanding business area with a focus on trucks, trailers and other heavy-duty applications.As part of the team, you will work in a dynamic international environment with experienced technical and commercial colleagues, contributing to the development of a business with strong growth ambitions.Location: The preferred base is FTZ's headquarters in Rørup, Denmark. Candidates living in Southern Sweden are also welcome to apply. The role requires regular on-site presence in Rørup, especially during the initial onboarding period. The practical setup will be discussed with the selected candidate.KontaktuppgifterContactIn this recruitment, MEKO Danmark is partnering with Autorekrytering. If you have any questions regarding the position or the recruitment process, please feel free to contact Clemens Döring, Clemens.doring@autorekrytering.se.We look forward to your application!

jobs.description:
Location: Remote | Cape Town, Poland, Romania or locations close to the EU time zone.

Experience: 5+ years

Company: Coho
