jobs.title: Client Accounting Division Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Burkland's core purpose is to Accelerate Dreams. So often, turning dreams into reality helps change the world. We thrive at the forefront of this transformation. Startups desire our professionals as they are the best in the business. Startups seek our content because we are an industry thought leader. Startups trust our expertise, so founders can focus on their companies, products, and value-add. Because of our demonstrated value, our clients have raised more than $17.8B!

At Burkland, we lead with our Core Purpose. We do this for both our clients and our employees. We believe that leaning on our Core Values (Fresh Perspectives, Exponential Value, Empathy, Trusted Partner) will lead to happy clients and happy employees.

We are a remote-first company with over 185 team members, more than 800 clients, and a culture built on doing meaningful work with people who genuinely care about helping our clients grow. Come build something with us!


Role Summary

The Client Accounting Division Manager runs their division as a self-contained business unit within Burkland. The role owns the division's P&L and staffing, and is accountable not only for its own scorecard but for the aggregate performance of every KPI held by roles within the division. Success is measured by both business and people outcomes: revenue, margin, utilization, service quality, and client retention, alongside the growth and engagement of the people doing the work. The division supports consumer and product-based startups, so the manager brings deep inventory and cost accounting expertise to guide the teamâs technical work and client advice.

This is a hands-on people leadership role. The manager is expected to understand strengths and development needs of each team member in their business unit, set clear expectations, give consistent feedback, address performance issues early, and build a team that can deliver both accounting and proactive advisory work at a high standard. The manager also owns key client relationships and serves as the first-line escalation point for client issues, with a defined handoff path for anything beyond their resolution.

This job description outlines the core of the role, but it isn't meant to cover everything you'll do. As Burkland grows, your responsibilities may shift and new projects, tasks, or priorities may be added along the way. We hope you'll see that as a chance to stretch, learn, and broaden your contributions.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Division Performance and KPI Accountability

  • Own the business unit's P&L, including revenue, margin, and utilization targets.

  • Drive aggregate performance across all KPIs assigned to Accounting Associates and Client Accounting Advisors, in addition to the manager's own scorecard.

  • Track division performance regularly, identify gaps early, and take corrective action at the individual and team level.

  • Report on division results to the Director of Accounting Advisory, including risks, trends, and planned actions.

  • Manage capacity and workload distribution across the division as well as assigning clients.

  • Contribute to pricing and fixed-fee scoping, and monitor engagement profitability.

  • Maintain awareness of AR and collections for division clients and address issues with the appropriate teams.

People Leadership and Staffing

  • Set clear role expectations and performance goals tied to the KPIs each team member owns.

  • Lead regular, structured 1:1s focused on goals, workload, development, and wellbeing, not only status updates. Use them to give direct, ongoing feedback that recognizes strong work and addresses gaps as they appear, rather than waiting for review cycles.

  • Create clear growth plans and provide ongoing coaching to develop each team member, in partnership with the Director and People Team

  • Conduct performance reviews, manage performance concerns directly, and contribute to compensation and promotion recommendations.

  • Monitor team capacity and engagement to support retention and prevent burnout.

  • Apply company policies consistently, manage time-off and leave requests, and bring performance concerns, employee relations matters, and escalations to the Director and People Team for guidance and resolution.

  • Plan staffing against current and forecasted client demand and build the business case for new headcount.

  • Lead hiring for the division through interviewing and selection, and onboard new team members so they reach full productivity within expected timelines.

Inventory Accounting and Technical Oversight

  • Oversee inventory valuation, reconciliation, and physical and cycle count processes across the divisionâs client portfolio, making sure variances are investigated and resolved quickly.

  • Set standards for costing methods (FIFO, LIFO, weighted average) and ensure the team applies them correctly by client and industry.

  • Ensure the team delivers accurate GAAP financial statements, inventory reporting, and COGS and gross margin analysis tailored to each clientâs business model.

  • Guide ERP and inventory software implementations, migrations, and improvements (partnering with ERP specialist where needed), and ensure client records stay audit-ready (as appropriate for the engagement size and scope).

  • Coach the team to help clients reduce shrinkage, obsolescence, overstocking, and stockouts, and to improve working capital through metrics like inventory turnover and days on hand.

  • Strong understanding of supply chain methods such as contract manufacturing and 3PL operations

Client Relationships and Service Quality

  • Act as an escalation point for client relationship issues.

  • Oversee quality control to ensure deliverables meet firm standards.

  • Shift the team's work from solely report delivery toward proactive advisory.

Growth and Operations

  • Own growth of the division's book of business through business development efforts to expand existing client relationships and identify service-expansion opportunities

  • Maintain accurate, current portfolio information in Knownwell

  • Drive full adoption of firm tools, systems, and processes, including AI-enabled workflows

Group and Company Success

A One Burkland mindset:

Our clients are best served when teams work together, not in silos. Partner closely with Tax, CFO, HR, and other service lines to create consistency, share knowledge, and deliver a seamless client experience across Burkland.

  • Comfort with an increasing pace of change:

Today's pace is the slowest we will experience going forward, not a finish line before things settle. As AI and related tools evolve, our processes evolve with them. This allows for more chances to learn, grow, and shape how the work gets done.

  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI-driven efficiency:

Proactively look for smarter ways of working as new tools come online. This is about changing how the work gets done, not reducing the need for skilled people to do it.

  • A constructive attitude:

Attitude is contagious in both directions, across the team and with clients. Approach change with curiosity and enthusiasm. Help to set that tone for others rather than defaulting to resistance.

  • Full adoption of firm tools and processes:

Systems are critical to growth and often fail to be effective when only part of the team uses them well.

  • Delivery and proactive advisory:

Build real understanding of where each client's business is headed and advise ahead of it. Clients need the why behind their numbers, not just the numbers.

Core Competencies & Skills

  • Financial Acumen â cost management, margin analysis, fixed-fee scope adjustments, and AR/collections awareness.

  • Client Relationshipsâ Client relationship management, escalation handling, and spotting cross-sell and service-expansion opportunities.

  • Advisory mindset â Moving teams from report delivery alone to proactive advisory.

  • Leading Change â Champions of change, including AI-driven efficiency, leading by example in the consistent adoption of firm tools, systems and processes and reinforcing them across the team.

  • AI Fluency â Hands-on comfort using AI tools in accounting and operational work, with sound judgment about where AI adds value, where human review is required, and how to protect client data.

  • Cross-functional collaboration â Build strong working relationships across Service Delivery, partnering with other teams on shared client work and aligning with Growth on new client onboarding and cross-sell opportunities

  • Inventory and Cost Accounting Expertise â Deep knowledge of inventory accounting, costing methods, COGS, and GAAP, with the ability to guide a team through complex inventory work and system implementations. Strong understanding of supply chain methods such as contract manufacturing and 3PL operations as well as eCommerce operations and cash flows through Shopify, Amazon, eBay, and other marketplace solutions.

Minimum Requirements / Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business, accounting, finance, or a related field, and 5+ years of progressive professional experience

  • Direct people management experience, including conducting performance reviews, managing underperformance, and developing team members

  • Exceptional client relationship management skills and the ability to understand client needs

  • Strong project management skills, including the ability to prioritize, meet deadlines, and deliver high-quality results

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients, team members, and leadership

  • Curiosity, strong problem-solving skills, and an eagerness to take on new challenges involving emerging technology and industries

  • Strong command of GAAP and cost accounting, including inventory accounting (FIFO, LIFO, landed costs, shrinkage, and valuation adjustments)

Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA or CMA credential

  • Experience owning or significantly contributing to a team budget, P&L, or book of business

  • Prior experience leading a team within a professional services or client accounting environment

  • Hands-on ERP and inventory system experience (NetSuite, QuickBooks, Cin7, Fishbowl, or similar)

  • Experience leading or overseeing ERP or inventory software implementations

Â 

Physical & Environmental Demands

This is a remote position. Work is primarily performed at a computer for extended periods, requiring the ability to use a keyboard, view a screen, and communicate via video and phone. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

EEO Statement

Burkland Associates is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Burkland Associates is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or another legally protected status. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, please visit our careers page https://burklandassociates.com/careers/. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment-qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

The base pay range target for the role described in this job description is 120,000-140,000. Final offer amounts depend on multiple factors such as candidate experience and expertise, geographic location, total compensation, and market data. In addition, full-time regular positions are eligible for, 401(k), health benefits, and other benefits; some of these benefits may be available for part-time.

Â

People from across 20 disciplines are working within the Faculty. Along with the disciplinary approach a very ambitious interdisciplinary research culture has been developed. The faculty's research and teaching focuses on social, economic, political and educational issues with the common goal of contributing to an inclusive, open and resourceful society. Strategies for reducing barriers to service uptake and enhancement, including through the co-production of specialist knowledge, are essential for the legitimacy of services and underlying policies. The University of Luxembourg aims to play a key role in this public-facing co-productive knowledge landscape. jobs.title: (Senior) Operations Analyst - AIF Depositary (m/f)
jobs.description: (Senior) Operations Analyst - AIF Depositary (M/F)Luxembourg | req1179BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations. In its capacity as Depositary bank for Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs), Banque Internationale à Luxembourg SA (BIL) provides investor protection, through overseeing the general administration of the funds, the safekeeping of the fund's assets, the ownership verification and record keeping of other assets as well as the monitoring of the cash flows. Your role is to ensure that all depositary duties and obligations are performed in accordance with the applicable regulation.Your next challenge:• As part of the AIF Depositary team you will be responsible for safekeeping and verifying the ownership of the AIFs assets, monitor cash flow activities and perform oversight controls.• You will need to ensure that the procedures and controls comply with the applicable laws and keep up to date with legislation, professional standards and regulatory changes.• You will perform due diligences on fund service providers and be involved in on-site inspections.• Attending periodic client service meetings will also be part of your activities.• You will maintain and enhance depositary procedures, review programs and checklists.Your Profile:• Minimum 7 years of experience within the banking and financial services industry, including significant exposure to the Luxembourg fund industry.• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Audit, Law, or a related field.• Fluent in English, both written and spoken. French and/or German would be considered a strong asset. Any additional language will be viewed favourably.You possess excellent knowledge of:• AIFMD and the Luxembourg regulatory framework applicable to investment funds.• The role and responsibilities of a Depositary Bank.• Alternative asset classes, including Private Equity, Private Debt, Real Estate and Infrastructure.• Operational risk assessment, monitoring and process enhancement.• The key drivers, developments and trends shaping the European fund industry.You have a strong understanding of:• Banking organisations, operational workflows and risk management frameworks.• Financial products and services, including cash and treasury management, securities services, financing and capital markets solutions.• Microsoft Office applications.The following would be considered a strong asset:• Experience within an AIF Depositary function, particularly in investment restriction controls.• Professional certifications in audit, internal control and/or risk management.Personal competencies:• Strong team player with an entrepreneurial mindset and a collaborative, supportive attitude.• Excellent presentation, interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal.• Strong analytical capabilities combined with conceptual and strategic thinking.• Well-organised and results-driven, with the ability to deliver high-quality work within deadlines and effectively manage priorities.• Accurate, flexible and hands-on, with the ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced environment and under tight deadlines.BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience. BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all. NB: The selected candidate will be asked to provide an extract from the criminal record (no.3) as evidence of integrity and justified with regard to the specific needs of the position to be filled. Other documents will be collected, to the extent legally permitted, to perform background checks.

jobs.title: Resilience Risk Senior Manager (m/f)
jobs.description: Resilience Risk Senior ManagerPermanent contract At HSBC, we're a trusted international organisation with a global customer base of around 39 million customers worldwide through a network that covers 62 countries and territories. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank and we need talent like you to help us meet our ambition. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top or in an exciting new direction—we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further. The HSBC Group in Luxembourg is a significant employer and operates several businesses including asset management, securities services, private banking and corporate banking.By joining us, you'll help evolve and grow our Risk function. What you will do: Reporting to the Chief Risk Officer Luxembourg, you will oversee the implementation of the Non-Financial Risk (NFR) Strategy and an effective Risk Management Framework in Luxembourg. Acting as a 2LoD Risk Steward Specialist, you will demonstrate strong stewardship in line with NFR Risk Steward accountabilities, partnering with the 1LoD to embed Risk Policies and improve the risk profile across HSBC Luxembourg. The role has a particular focus on Technology and Cyber Security Risk and Controls.In this role, you will (but not limited to):• Support the Country CRO by partnering with the businesses and functions to support growth, profitability, return on tangible equity and sustainability aspirations, while maintaining the appropriate risk management discipline to achieve strategic goals. • Provide risk management input and stewardship on all Resilience Risk Management matters, including supporting the CRO in establishing and maintaining effective governance.• Ensure an appropriate risk governance structure is in place in line with HSBC Principles, Risk Management Framework and local regulatory requirements. • Establish and execute an effective non-financial risk framework for an integrated approach to operational, Technology and Cyber risk across the country.• Translate information risk, Transaction Processing Risk and Third-Party Risk into clear business terms for GB/GF stakeholders, helping them operate within risk appetite by recommending mitigating actions. • Maintain oversight of Non-Financial Risks in the country, with a strong understanding of local regulatory requirements, DORA, and Technology and Cyber regulations, including the Review and Challenge of risk assessment, incidents and issues.You should apply if you have: • Deep expertise in Risk Management, particularly Resilience Risk and Operational Risk, as well as Technology and Cyber Security risks. Knowledge of DORA would be considered as a strong asset.• The ability to implement a vision and strategy for risk capability across global functions, and to secure buy-in from key stakeholders, including C-suite leaders.  • Proven ability to navigate complex organisations. • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills with internal and external stakeholders, enabling effective delivery of vision and strategy.• Experience in handling complex issues pragmatically, identifying core security and business requirements and translating them into clear, actionable activities.• Experience delivering transformation and change programmes.• Business fluency in English.Even if you feel you do not meet 100% of our qualifications, we encourage you to apply, if you believe this role is right for you.What you'll get in return:The pay range for this role is €116,200 – €140,000.HSBC operates multiple variable pay plans, to reflect the diverse nature of the businesses, roles and markets in which we operate. Variable pay is designed to reward colleagues for their individual performance and contribution, as well as the performance of their relevant Business / Infrastructure, and the overall Group.We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits usually covering health support, life assurance, pension, and family friendly leaves, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.HSBC has been certified “Top Employer 2026” in Europe. This recognition from the Top Employers Institute rewards our HR practices and recognises HSBC as an HR Leader in France, Germany, Italy, Ireland, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Poland and Spain.If you're looking for a career where you will be respected as an individual and valued for the contributions you make, please visit our career page, and discover how diversity drives our success. Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we're dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please let us know.Please note that every selected candidate will have to provide us with a valid criminal record check in due time.Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. For any GDPR request, please send it to: lux.data.privacy@hsbc.comFor further information on building your career at HSBC, please visit: www.hsbc.com/careers   Discover how ‘We Value Difference'.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive (London)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



Replit is experiencing extraordinary demand and seeking an Enterprise Account Executive with strong communication skills to drive our hyper-growth. Candidates with SaaS experience, particularly with some technical background (i.e. having some coding knowledge or prior experience at other developer tool companies) are ideal.



This full-cycle sales position encompasses new client acquisition. We believe this role offers a distinctive opportunity for people who excel in client-facing situations and have a passion for driving sales and AI. You'll leverage your skills to effectively communicate Replit's value proposition: a world where anyone can create software using natural language.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Evangelize a future where anyone can create software in natural language, ushering in a change in the nature of the firm on par with the PC era

 - Serve as the primary point of contact for prospects and customers, guiding them through the buying journey

 - Conduct compelling product demonstrations and help realize the art of the possible by orchestrating non-engineering hackathons

 - Articulate Replit's value proposition and align it with customers' business objectives

 - Collaborate with product and engineering teams to ensure technical accuracy and successful delivery

 - Prepare tailored quotes and skillfully negotiate deals

 - Maintain accurate customer and forecasting data in Replit’s CRM (Hubspot)

 - Foster strong relationships with existing clients while identifying opportunities for expanded adoption

 - Optimize customers' use of the Replit platform through ongoing collaboration and support

 - Gather and communicate valuable customer feedback, championing their interests within Replit



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Experience in AE or SE/technical sales role, preferably in SaaS or developer tools

 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas

 - Experience with, or direct observations of full-cycle sales, from prospecting to closing deals to managing existing customers

 - Proficiency in using CRM systems and sales tools (e.g., Hubspot)

 - Ability to quickly learn and articulate the value of new technologies

 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think on your feet

 - Self-motivated with excellent time management and organizational skills

 - Passion for technology and staying current with industry trends

 - Experience with or strong interest in AI and machine learning is a plus

 - Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time for client meetings and events
   
   


NICE TO HAVE:

 - You're an active Replit user

 - You've worked at an early-stage startup or in developer tools

 - Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience)
   
   


TOOLS + TECH STACK FOR THIS ROLE:

 - Replit

 - Hubspot CRM

 - ZoomInfo

 - Clay

 - SmartLead

 - LinkedIn Sales Navigator

 - Hashboard, Hex
   
   


THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE A FIT IF:

 - You’re not based in London area

 - You lack an understanding of the software development lifecycle; have little to no coding knowledge

 - You’re not passionate about AI

 - You don’t enjoy being in client facing roles where 80% of your day is talking to others





Note: This role will begin as remote, with plans to transition to a hybrid model once we establish a local office presence.

  • Utvrđivanje i otklanjanje kvarova na strojevima
  • Izvođenje servisa, remonta i montaže strojeva
  • Briga o zalihi rezervnih dijelova
  • Godišnje provođenje ispitivanja elektro uređaja

Što donosiš sa sobom:

  • Završena škola: elektrotehničar, elektromehaničar, mehatroničar ili električar, stručnjak za pneumatiku i hidrauliku
  • Poželjno radno iskustvo minimalno 2 godine u području održavanja pneumatskih i hidrauličnih strojeva
  • Pouzdanost i samostalnost u obavljanju radnih zadataka
  • Izraženi timski duh
  • Fleksibilnost
  • Poželjno poznavanje engleskog ili njemačkog jezika u govoru i pismu

Što te očekuje:

  • Rad u internacionalnom okruženju
  • Stimulativna primanja
  • Mogućnost napredovanja
  • Ugovor na neodređeno vrijeme
  • Poticajna i prijateljska radna atmosfera
  • Uvođenje u posao pod vodstvom mentora
  • Dvosmjenski rad
  • Vrhunska oprema i postrojenje
  • Veliki benefit paket (npr. team building, božićni domjenak, sportske aktivnosti, osiguranje 0-24, uplata u 3. mirovinski stup i još mnoge pogodnosti)

jobs.title: STRUČNI SURADNIK-PEDAGOG / STRUČNA SURADNICA-PEDAGOGINJA NA TALIJANSKOM JEZIKU
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08, 86/09, 92/10,105/10-ispr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i sukladno Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja radnika u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ te čl. 7. Pravilnika o radu OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“, ravnateljica Osnovne škole-Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“ Rijeka, Mirka Čurbega 18, objavljuje N A T J E Č A J za popunjenje radnog mjesta
  • 1 stručni suradnik/stručna suradnica – pedagog/pedagoginja na talijanskom jeziku na određeno i puno radno vrijeme (zamjena) uz uvjet probnog rada prema odredbama Temeljnog kolektivnog ugovora za službenike i namještenike u javnim službama
TRAŽENI UVJETI: 1. Prema čl. 105. i 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12., 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17 i 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i sukladno čl. 29., st. 1. a) Pravilnika o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi (NN br. 6/19, 75/20):
  • završen sveučilišni diplomski studij
  • potpuno vladanje talijanskim jezikom i pismom
2. Prema Zakonu o odgoju i obrazovanju na jeziku i pismu nacionalnih manjina (NN 51/00.,56/00-ispr.). Na oglašena radna mjesta mogu se javiti osobe oba spola, sukladno čl. 13. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (NN 82/16, 69/17). Svi izrazi korišteni u natječaju odnose se na osobe oba spola. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu kandidati su dužni priložiti:
  • životopis (CV) sastavljen na hrvatskom i na talijanskom jeziku,
  • presliku diplome, odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi,
  • dokaz o državljanstvu,
  • elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje i
  • uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od 6 mjeseci od dana objave ovog natječaja.
Navedenu dokumentaciju potrebno je dostaviti neposredno ili poštom preporučeno na adresu škole, u roku od 8 dana od dana objave ovog natječaja na mrežnoj stranici Škole i mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje. Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici. Kandidati koji ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priznatom statusu. Osobe koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu dostaviti i dokaze iz stavka 1. članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji su dostavili potpune i pravovremene prijave i koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja sudjeluju u daljnjem postupku te će biti pozvani na vrednovanje. Vrednovanje uključuje: psihologijsko testiranje, provjera poznavanja talijanskog jezika za kandidate koji nisu završili najmanje jedan obrazovni ciklus na talijanskom jeziku, sastav motivacijskog pisma i intervju, sve u skladu s odredbama članaka 12. – 14. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi – Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“. Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Povjerenstvo za provedbu testiranja će postupiti sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ u odnosu na sve kandidate, koji udovoljavaju propisanim uvjetima, a podnijeli su potpune i pravovremene prijave. Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu za bilo koju fazu vrednovanja, smatrat će se da je odustao od daljnjeg natječajnog postupka. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati daju privolu za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u svim dostavljenim prilozima odnosno ispravama za potrebe provedbe natječajnog postupka. Škola će u roku od 8 dana od donošenja odluke o izboru kandidata obavijestiti sve kandidate o rezultatima natječaja objavom odluke na mrežnoj stranici Škole ili osobno putem elektroničke pošte. Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnoj stranici škole, te na mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje dana 2. studenog 2026. godine. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Ai sensi dell'articolo 107 della Legge sull’educazione e l’istruzione nella scuola primaria e secondaria (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e in conformità al Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione e ai sensi dell'articolo 7 del Regolamento interno per l'assunzione del personale della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”, la direttrice della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò” di Fiume, Via Mirko Čurbeg 18, bandisce il C O N C O R S O per il posto di lavoro
  • 1 collaboratore/collaboratrice professionale – pedagogista in lingua italiana – orario completo, a tempo determinato (supplenza) con la condizione del periodo di prova secondo il Contratto collettivo essenziale per gli ufficiali negli enti pubblici
CONDIZIONI RICHIESTE: 1. Condizioni previste dagli articoli 105 e 106 della Legge sull’educazione e l’istruzione nella scuola primaria e secondaria (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e in conformita' all'articolo 29, comma 1 a) del Regolamento sulla qualificha e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare (GU 6/19, 75/20):
  • laurea
  • padronanza della lingua e della scrittura italiana
2. Condizioni specifiche in base alla Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione nella lingua e scrittura delle minoranze nazionali (GU 51/00, 56/00-corr.). Al Concorso possono partecipare i candidati di entrambi i sessi come previsto dall'articolo 13 della Legge sulle pari opportunità dei sessi (GU n. 82/16, 69/17). I termini usati in questo Bando di concorso si riferiscono a persone di entrambi i sessi. Le domande firmate devono essere corredate dalla seguente documentazione:
  • dati biografici (Curriculum vitae) redatti in lingua croata e in lingua italiana,
  • il Diploma di laurea, ovvero la prova attestante il grado d'istruzione e la qualifica professionale,
  • la prova di cittadinanza,
  • il Certificato/estratto digitale di dati dalla banca dati dell'HZMO e
  • l'attestato comprovante l'assenza di condanne penali considerate ostacoli per l'assunzione indicate nell'art. 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (con data di scadenza negli ultimi 6 mesi dalla data di pubblicazione del concorso).
La documentazione indicata deve pervenire all'indirizzo della scuola, consegnata personalmente o spedita per posta raccomandata, entro e non oltre il termine di 8 giorni dalla pubblicazione del presente Bando di Concorso sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato. I documenti vanno consegnati in copia non autenticata. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego, a parità di condizioni, in base a leggi specifiche, devono evocare questo diritto esplicitamente nella domanda e fornire in allegato oltre ai documenti comprovanti l'idoneità secondo i requisiti richesti, pure i documenti comprovanti lo status riconosciuto. Le persone di cui all'art.102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), art. 48. f della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi di guerra militari e civili di (GU 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), art. 9 della Legge sulla riabilitazione professionale e l'impiego di persone disabili (GU 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) e l'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno comprovare il loro status con la documentazione indicata nella Legge speciale, che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nei confronti degli altri candidati esclusivamente alle stesse condizioni. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego secondo l'art. 102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), dovranno allegare anche le prove indicate nell'art. 103, comma 1 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari, che si trova sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego in base all'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno indicare questo diritto ed allegare le prove indicate nell'art. 49, comma 1 della stessa Legge, indicate sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf I candidati che hanno inoltrato le domande complete e tempestive e che soddisfano le condizioni formali del concorso partecipano nella procedura ulteriore e saranno invitati alla prova (test). La prova (test) include: test psicologici, verifiche della conoscenza della lingua italiana per coloro che non hanno finito almeno un ciclo di istruzione in lingua italiana, la stesura della lettera motivazionale ed il colloquio, tutto indicato ai sensi degli articoli 12 – 14 del Regolamento sulle modalità e sulla procedura di assunzione della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”. Le domande incomplete e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito non verranno prese in considerazione. La Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni procederà secondo le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE »San Nicolò« con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Se il candidato non accede a una delle fasi della prova (test) si considererà come se avesse rinunciato alla procedura concorsuale ulteriore. Accedendo al Bando di concorso i candidati danno il proprio consenso all'elaborazione dei dati personali presenti in tutti i documenti allegati. La Scuola avviserà tutti i candidati riguardo ai risultati del concorso, entro 8 giorni dalla data della decisione sulla scelta del candidato, pubblicando la decisione sul sito web della Scuola oppure personalmente tramite posta elettronica. Il Bando di concorso è stato pubblicato sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato il 2 novembre 2026.

jobs.title: PRODAJNI/A SAVJETNIK/CA – PRODAJA SOLARNIH ELEKTRANA
jobs.description: TERENSKI/A PRODAJNI/A PREDSTAVNIK/CA ZA SOLARNE ELEKTRANE Green Bean traži prodajnu osobu za aktivno pronalaženje kupaca solarnih elektrana, prvenstveno vlasnika obiteljskih kuća. Kako izgleda posao? Glavninu rada čine terenski obilasci sela i manjih mjesta u okolici Zagreba. Obilazite dodijeljeno područje, neposredno pristupate vlasnicima kuća i započinjete razgovore o mogućnosti ugradnje solarne elektrane. Važan dio posla čine kontakti bez prethodno dogovorenog sastanka. Očekujemo da samostalno stvarate nove prodajne prilike te zainteresirane kupce pratite od prvog razgovora do ugovaranja. Glavni poslovi: • planiranje i obilazak dodijeljenog područja • osobno kontaktiranje vlasnika kuća i predstavljanje ponude • prepoznavanje interesa i prikupljanje podataka potrebnih za izradu ponude • dogovaranje daljnjih sastanaka i tehničkih obilazaka • prezentacija ponuda te redoviti telefonski, e-mail i osobni kontakt s kupcima do njihove odluke • vođenje evidencije kontakata i prodajnih aktivnosti • suradnja s tehničkim i operativnim timom Koga tražimo? Osobu kojoj odgovara svakodnevni teren, koja može samostalno započeti razgovor s nepoznatom osobom i ustrajno pratiti prodajne prilike. Važno nam je kako pristupate kupcu, slušate njegove potrebe i postupate nakon odbijanja. Prednost imaju kandidati s dokazivim iskustvom u samostalnom pronalaženju i pridobivanju novih kupaca, osobito kroz neposrednu terensku prodaju. Iskustvo sa solarnim elektranama ili tehničkim proizvodima predstavlja prednost, ali nije uvjet. Osiguravamo edukaciju o solarnim elektranama i našem prodajnom procesu. Obavezni su vozačka dozvola B kategorije i spremnost na svakodnevnu vožnju i terenski rad. Što nudimo? • fiksnu mjesečnu plaću od najmanje 1.100 EUR neto • bonus vezan uz ostvarene prodajne rezultate • službeno vozilo za obavljanje posla tijekom radnog vremena • edukaciju o solarnim elektranama i prodajnom procesu • suradnju s tehničkim i operativnim timom Prijava: Pošaljite životopis na info@greenbean.hr i kratko, vlastitim riječima, odgovorite na dva pitanja: 1. Opišite jednu prodaju kupcu kojeg ste sami pronašli. Kako ste došli do njega, što ste osobno poduzeli i kako je završilo? Ako nemate takvo iskustvo, navedite to. 2. Zamislite da tijekom obilaska sela prilazite vlasniku kuće koji Vas ne očekuje. Kako biste započeli razgovor i što biste rekli ako odgovori: „Ne zanima me“

jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect (f/m/d)  IT/OT Security Platforms (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description: Together, we make the differenceSiemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.As a Solution Architect (f/m/d) for our IT/OT Security Platforms you will define the technical vision and architecture for strategic service offerings. You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts.As part of our team, you will have- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interestsSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.What part will you play?- You design and evolve the target architecture for our IT/OT Security Platforms (SINEC Secure Connect), ensuring alignment with Siemens cybersecurity, operational, and business requirements. - You define secure IT/OT communication concepts based on Zero Trust principles and develop architectures for remote access, machine connectivity, application communication, and future AI-driven use cases. - You support Siemens factories in integrating modern security and management solutions into existing brownfield environments, considering legacy systems, industrial protocols, and operational constraints. - You translate business, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform architectures, governance models, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps. - You collaborate with factories, cybersecurity teams, service owners, vendors, and technology partners to establish architecture standards and drive service adoption across Siemens. - You define integration concepts between connectivity services, monitoring solutions, automation frameworks, and enterprise systems. - You evaluate new technologies and architecture patterns and contribute to the continuous evolution of Siemens' IT/OT security and platform landscape. - You enable data-driven and AI-supported operational use cases by designing architectures that support secure data flows, automation, analytics, and platform interoperability. - You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services.What you bring to the table- Education: You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a comparable qualification. - Experience & Skills:- You possess strong expertise in Zero Trust and OT Security Architecture, including concepts such as identity-centric networking, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and industry frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207 and IEC 62443. - You have proven experience with OT Infrastructure and Brownfield Integration (of at least 3+ years), including industrial environments, legacy systems, machine-to-machine communication, industrial protocols, network segmentation, and hybrid IT/OT architectures. - You are experienced in Platform and Enterprise Architecture (of at least 3+ years) and can translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions, governance models, operating concepts, and technology roadmaps. - You possess strong capabilities in Platform Integration, Automation, AI and Analytics, including API-based integration, monitoring, automation, operational data flows, and AI-ready platform design. - You are able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and successfully align diverse stakeholder groups.- Ways of working:- You work in a structured and strategic manner and are comfortable operating in international and cross-functional environments. - You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).- Languages: Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About usWe know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority.Our global,diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!www.siemens.de/careers (http://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs.html) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.FAQ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/jobs/faq/) – if you need further information on the application process.

You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts.As part of our team, you will have- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interestsSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.What part will you play?- You design and evolve the target architecture for our IT/OT Security Platforms (SINEC Secure Connect), ensuring alignment with Siemens cybersecurity, operational, and business requirements. - You define secure IT/OT communication concepts based on Zero Trust principles and develop architectures for remote access, machine connectivity, application communication, and future AI-driven use cases. - You support Siemens factories in integrating modern security and management solutions into existing brownfield environments, considering legacy systems, industrial protocols, and operational constraints. - You translate business, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform architectures, governance models, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps. - You collaborate with factories, cybersecurity teams, service owners, vendors, and technology partners to establish architecture standards and drive service adoption across Siemens. - You define integration concepts between connectivity services, monitoring solutions, automation frameworks, and enterprise systems. - You evaluate new technologies and architecture patterns and contribute to the continuous evolution of Siemens' IT/OT security and platform landscape. - You enable data-driven and AI-supported operational use cases by designing architectures that support secure data flows, automation, analytics, and platform interoperability. - You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services.What you bring to the table- Education: You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a comparable qualification. - Experience & Skills:- You possess strong expertise in Zero Trust and OT Security Architecture, including concepts such as identity-centric networking, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and industry frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207 and IEC 62443. - You have proven experience with OT Infrastructure and Brownfield Integration (of at least 3+ years), including industrial environments, legacy systems, machine-to-machine communication, industrial protocols, network segmentation, and hybrid IT/OT architectures. - You are experienced in Platform and Enterprise Architecture (of at least 3+ years) and can translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions, governance models, operating concepts, and technology roadmaps. - You possess strong capabilities in Platform Integration, Automation, AI and Analytics, including API-based integration, monitoring, automation, operational data flows, and AI-ready platform design. - You are able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and successfully align diverse stakeholder groups.- Ways of working:- You work in a structured and strategic manner and are comfortable operating in international and cross-functional environments. - You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).- Languages: Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About usWe know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority.Our global,diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!www.siemens.de/careers (http://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs.html) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.FAQ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/jobs/faq/) – if you need further information on the application process.

jobs.title: Productization Specialist
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Productization Specialist / Product Lifecycle Engineer to join a New Product Introduction (NPI) team responsible for bringing new products successfully from development into production.

Note! This application is only for individuals already residing in Finland, and relocation is not possible.

In this role, you will act as a key link between R&D, production, sales, and business operations, ensuring that new products, features, and solutions are implemented efficiently and according to agreed processes. You will play an important role in developing productization practices, supporting projects, and helping the organization scale new products into successful business.

Key Responsibilities:
 Coordinate the implementation of new products into production
 Develop and maintain productization concepts and best practices
 Support R&D, production, and sales throughout different project phases
 Ensure adherence to agreed business processes and transfer-to-business procedures
 Gather and specify requirements for new functionalities and process improvements
 Participate in testing and validation activities

What Were Looking For:
 B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Engineering or a related field
 Minimum 2 years of experience in productization, NPI, manufacturing engineering, or a similar role

- Do you have experience using Azure DevOps or similar lifecycle management tools?*

jobs.title: Component Engineer

Note! This application is only for individuals already residing in Finland, and relocation is not possible.

What we are looking for:
- B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Electronics Engineering or a related field
- Minimum 2 years of experience as an Electronics Designer, Component Engineer, or in a similar role

- Strong technical understanding of one or more of the following areas:
 Digital components (microprocessors, FPGAs, memories)
 Analog components (A/D converters, amplifiers, switches)
 Discrete components (transistors, diodes, resistors, capacitors)
 Electromechanical components (connectors, cables, cooling solutions)
 Transformers and magnetic components
 Optical components
 Display and touchscreen technologies

While the role covers a broad range of component technologies, the current focus is particularly on electromechanical and mechanical components, making experience from mechanical engineering, product design, or industrial hardware development valuable.

jobs.title: Freelance Copywriter
jobs.description:
CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role.

 

The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.

 

About the Role

Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:

  • Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands
  • Skincare and beauty
  • Tech and software
  • Finance and investing
  • Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability
  • Education
  • Home improvement
  • Automobiles and motorcycles
  • Health and wellness
  • Medical and clinical fields
  • Digital marketing
  • SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing

Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities
  • Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites
  • Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy
  • Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors
  • Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices
  • Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing
  • Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team

Qualifications
  • Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills
  • 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred
  • Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices
  • Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics
  • Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content
  • Portfolio featuring published work preferred
  • Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred

Compensation

Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.

Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate

This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page

After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate

After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate

 

Application Process

Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

jobs.title: Køkkenchef, India Spice – Fuldtid
jobs.description:
India Spice is a passionate Indian restaurant and catering kitchen with a deep love for rich flavors, authentic spices, and traditional culinary craftsmanship.

We are best known for our vibrant North and South Indian specialties, aromatic curries, andtandoor dishes, but most importantly, we believe in making authentic food from scratch,using fresh, high-quality ingredients and taking pride in the tradition behind everything we serve.

For us, India Spice is about more than serving great meals. It is about warm hospitality, creating memorable dining experiences, and treating our guests, team members, and partners with respect. We are an ambitious, growing business, but we also want India Spice to be a workplace where people take pride in what they do, enjoy coming to work, and feel a shared responsibility for our quality and standards.

Currently, our operations cover our busy restaurant service, takeaway, and event catering, and we are looking for the right person to take responsibility for the day-to-day organization and operational flow of our kitchen.

About the position

As our Kitchen Manager, you will play a central role in keeping the kitchen structured, efficient, and running smoothly across daily prep, restaurant service, and catering orders.

Key Responsibilities:

• Overall coordination and operational organization of the kitchen

• Maintaining strict hygiene and food safety standards according to Danish Fødevarestyrelsen regulations

• Staff scheduling and daily task delegation for kitchen and prep staff

• Overseeing kitchen maintenance, ensuring equipment, tandoors, and workstations remain clean and in peak condition

• Purchasing, ordering ingredients, spices, packaging, and operational supplies

• Inventory management and stock control to ensure availability for high-volume weekends and large catering orders

• Establishing clear prep routines, portion control, and workflow improvements as our catering demands expand

• Collaborating closely with our chefs and front-of-house team to ensure consistent food quality and punctual service

Qualifications & Qualities:

• Experience working in a professional kitchen, catering operation, or food production environment is an advantage, but having the right mindset is what matters most.

• You are structured, dependable, and punctual, with natural ownership over your responsibilities.

• You are proactive, notice details quickly, and thrive when bringing order and smooth routines to a fast-paced environment.

• You communicate clearly and comfortably in English (Danish is a plus, but not required).

Practical Information

• Position: Kitchen Manager

• Hours: Full-time (37 hours per week)

• Location: Søborg Hovedgade 118, 2860 Søborg

• Salary: Competitive, based on qualifications and experience

• Start Date: As soon as possible / By agreement

How to apply

Send your application and CV to info@indiaspice.dk with the subject line "Application: Kitchen Manager – India Spice".

If you have any questions regarding the role or India Spice, feel free to contact us at info@indiaspice.dk.

We review applications continuously and look forward to hearing from you — and hopefully welcoming you to the India Spice family.

jobs.title: Support Engineer I (FC, Weekend Shift)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


As a Support Engineer you are at the forefront of helping those developers create. In a given day you’ll help folks with all sorts of things ranging from general Replit usage questions, identifying and debugging issues on the platform and helping to build and maintain the tools we use. We use tools like Zendesk, Linear, Slack, and Replit itself to get the job done. We also value solving the problems we can ourselves. We have a number of tools we build and maintain ourselves.



You will work on a small, global team of support specialists and engineers united by Replit's mission to make the next billion software creators. Together, you'll ensure developers worldwide have the support they need to bring their ideas to life.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Work directly with Replit customers via support tickets to solve technical product issues, bugs, and provide technical guidance while meeting daily ticket volume and resolution time targets.

 - Collaborate with the rest of the Support team in telling the story of our users to the rest of Replit.

 - Directly contribute to and maintain the Support team's Knowledge Base.

 - Support customer-facing communications for outages and incidents and swiftly report ongoing bugs for Eng to triage and fix.




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Prior experience in software development or relevant technical support experience

 - Proven ability to work efficiently in fast-paced, high-volume support environments with strict productivity metrics.

 - Strong time management and ticket triage skills with comfort in performance tracking and regular reporting.

 - Excellent communication skills with initiative to ask questions when encountered with the unknown.

 - Experience with support tools and ticketing systems (e.g. Zendesk)




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Has used Replit in the last 3 to 6 months.

 - Experience working with IDEs, terminals, or other common developer tools.

 - Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)




WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex operational challenges systematically and devise effective solutions

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams

 - Strong communication skills: Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Continuous learning: Passion for staying current with industry best practices and new technologies

 - Focus on automation: Strong belief in automating repetitive tasks and building self-healing systems



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The schedule follows a Saturday through Wednesday work week, with an in-office requirement on Mondays and Wednesdays.

jobs.title: Directeur multisites - H/F (H/F)
jobs.description: Notre client est un groupe familial d'hôteliers passionnés, présent en France depuis plus de 50 ans, exploitant une 10aine d'établissements, sous franchise ou en marque propre. Animé par des valeurs de Responsabilité, d'Audace, de Respect et d'Excellence, le groupe place l'expérience client au cœur de ses priorités et poursuit son développement avec l'ambition d'offrir une qualité de service constante « dans l'exceptionnel comme dans le traditionnel ». Nous recherchons pour leur combo situé à Montpellier, leur futur : Directeur multisites - H/F- CDI - Statut Cadre Autonome- Basé à Montpellier- Nombreux avantages Vos motivations :Vous souhaitez diriger un véritable lieu de vie, réunissant deux établissements au cœur de Montpellier et accueillant une clientèle diversifiée.Vous êtes motivé par l'opportunité d'accompagner la montée en gamme du site, de piloter les travaux associés et de mettre à profit votre excellente compréhension des enjeux opérationnels.Vous recherchez un établissement proposant une offre complète, avec des activités F&B, séminaires et bar, et présentant un réel potentiel de développement commercial.Vous appréciez les fonctions de Direction dans lesquelles la commercialisation occupe une place centrale, notamment dans un contexte de repositionnement et de montée en gamme. Vous privilégiez également les fonctions de Direction résolument opérationnelles, au plus près des équipes et des réalités du terrain. Enfin, vous êtes à l'aise dans l'environnement d'un groupe familial et appréciez de travailler aux côtés de véritables hôteliers, experts et passionnés.Vos missions : Expérience client : Développer et maintenir une expérience client en adéquation aux valeurs de la marque. Suivre le déroulement du séjour des clients. Veiller à améliorer en permanence l'expérience client en identifiant les points d'amélioration. Gérer les situations de conflit ou d'insatisfaction de la clientèle. Assurer le suivi de la e-réputation en apportant les réponses à chaque commentaire client.Développement commercial : En collaboration avec le siège, élaborer ou appliquer une politique commerciale pour atteindre le CA budgété. Entretenir des relations commerciales productives en interne et en externe. Analyser le marché et la concurrence locale. Contrôler et évaluer la qualité du service rendu. Fixer le prix des prestations.Management et animation d'équipe : Coordonner et animer le travail de toutes les équipes de l'hôtel. Évaluer les compétences nécessaires à la qualité du service, les recruter. Superviser l'ensemble des activités de l'hôtel, soit en direct, soit par délégation auprès de ses chefs de service. S'appuyer sur les compétences internes tout en assurant la responsabilité finale.Gestion & Performance : Contrôler et évaluer la performance & rentabilité de l'établissement (gestion des comptes d'exploitation, pricing, TO, marge,). Optimiser les coûts en respectant le budget annuel validé. Élaborer et exploiter des tableaux de bord de suivi de l'activité. Mettre en place ou utiliser des outils de reporting. Prendre des décisions (ou faire des propositions) sur les investissements. Mettre en place des processus internes à l'Etablissement. Respecter les processus internes du Groupe et de la marque (Charte).Votre profil :Issu d'une formation en hôtellerie-restauration, vous justifiez d'une expérience réussie en direction d'hôtel 4* ou 5* avec restauration. Professionnel de terrain, vous maîtrisez l'ensemble des enjeux d'exploitation (hébergement, restauration, RM, OTA) et disposez d'une forte sensibilité commerciale. Manager engagé et rompu aux enjeux terrains, vous savez fédérer vos équipes avec leadership et exemplarité. Autonome, organisé et orienté résultat, vous êtes capable de piloter un établissement dans toutes ses dimensions. La maîtrise de l'anglais est indispensable.

jobs.title: LEDIG STILLING- ØKONOMIANSVARLIG – BEBOERØKONOMI
jobs.description:
Vil du bidra til en trygg og forsvarlig økonomisk oppfølging av beboerne våre?

Voss ordinære asylmottak søker en strukturert, nøyaktig og ansvarsbevisst økonomiansvarlig med hovedansvar for beboerøkonomi og refusjonskrav til Utlendingsdirektoratet (UDI).

Hva vi ser etter

Kvalifikasjoner

Vi ønsker at du har:

  • Utdanning innen økonomi, regnskap eller administrasjon. Relevant erfaring kan kompensere for formell utdanning.

  • God tallforståelse og gode ferdigheter i Excel.

  • Gode digitale ferdigheter.

  • Evne til å arbeide strukturert og håndtere flere oppgaver samtidig.

  • Gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig.

  • Evne til å håndtere konfidensiell informasjon på en trygg og profesjonell måte.

Erfaring med økonomiadministrasjon, refusjonskrav, dokumentasjonsarbeid eller arbeid ved asylmottak vil være en fordel. Kjennskap til UDIs regelverk og rutiner for økonomiske ytelser og refusjoner er ønskelig.

Personlige egenskaper

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Møter alle beboere med respekt, verdighet og forståelse, uavhengig av bakgrunn og livssituasjon.

  • Er rolig, tålmodig og behersket, også i utfordrende situasjoner.

  • Håndterer stress og arbeider effektivt under press.

  • Er nøyaktig, strukturert og ansvarsbevisst.

  • Har høy integritet og behandler fortrolige opplysninger med diskresjon.

  • Arbeider selvstendig og tar initiativ innenfor eget ansvarsområde.

  • Er løsningsorientert og håndterer uforutsette situasjoner på en profesjonell måte.

  • Har gode samarbeidsevner og kommuniserer tydelig og respektfullt med både beboere og kolleger.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidsoppgaver

1. Beboerøkonomi

  • Administrere og følge opp beboernes økonomiske ytelser.

  • Beregne og kontrollere utbetalinger i henhold til gjeldende satser og retningslinjer.

  • Sørge for korrekt og rettidig utbetaling av økonomiske ytelser.

  • Registrere og dokumentere alle utbetalinger.

  • Kontrollere utbetalingslister, kvitteringer og økonomiske bilag.

  • Følge opp endringer i beboernes situasjon som påvirker økonomiske ytelser.

  • Utarbeide oversikter og rapporter knyttet til beboerøkonomi.

2. Refusjonskrav til UDI

  • Utarbeide, kontrollere og sende refusjonskrav til UDI i henhold til gjeldende rutiner og frister.

  • Kontrollere at utgifter som kreves refundert, er dokumentert og oppfyller gjeldende vilkår.

  • Sikre at nødvendig dokumentasjon, bilag og kvitteringer vedlegges refusjonskravene.

  • Følge opp innsendte refusjonskrav og eventuelle spørsmål eller tilbakemeldinger fra UDI.

  • Registrere og følge opp godkjente, avslåtte og utestående refusjonskrav.

  • Bidra til god intern økonomikontroll og korrekt rapportering av refusjonsberettigede utgifter.

3. Generelle administrative oppgaver

  • Sikre forsvarlig arkivering og behandling av økonomiske opplysninger.

  • Følge opp økonomiske avvik og bidra til gode interne kontrollrutiner.

  • Samarbeide tett med mottaksleder og øvrige ansatte.

  • Gi beboerne nødvendig informasjon om økonomiske ytelser og utbetalingsrutiner.

Vi tilbyr

Vi tilbyr

  • En meningsfull stilling i et viktig samfunnsoppdrag.

  • Varierte arbeidsoppgaver med et tydelig ansvarsområde.

  • Et inkluderende og engasjert arbeidsmiljø.

  • Muligheten til å bidra til god økonomisk forvaltning og forsvarlig drift av mottaket.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Lilandtunet AS

Lilandtunet AS er et norsk selskap med base i Voss, Vestland. Selskapet har bakgrunn fra hotell- og gjestfrihetsbransjen, men har tilpasset sin virksomhet til å tilby innkvartering for asylsøkere.

I dag driver Lilandtunet AS Voss ordinære asylmottak på oppdrag fra Utlendingsdirektoratet (UDI), gjennom en inngått driftsavtale. Selskapet er opptatt av å tilby trygge, verdige og forsvarlige boforhold, og å skape et inkluderende og godt miljø for beboerne, samtidig som virksomheten drives på en profesjonell og ansvarlig måte.

jobs.title: Barchef søges til Sukiaba på toppen af det ikoniske Bella Sky
jobs.description:
Barchef – SUKAIBA

Vil du stå i spidsen for en af Københavns mest spektakulære cocktailbarer?

På toppen af Bella Sky finder du Restaurant Sukaiba – en Restaurant og Cocktail bar som er en del af Norrlyst Koncernen, hvor gastronomi, udsigt og atmosfære smelter sammen i en helstøbt gæsteoplevelse.

Her forenes asiatisk inspireret gastronomi med ambitiøse vin- og cocktailparringer og en professionel servicekultur, hvor kvalitet, kreativitet og værtskab går hånd i hånd.

Vi søger nu en passioneret og visionær Barchef, der vil tage ejerskab over vores cocktailbar og være med til at udvikle den til noget helt særligt. En fagligt stærk profil, der brænder for cocktails, værtskab og ledelse, og som kan skabe retning, engagement og høj kvalitet i baren.

ROLLEN

Som Barchef får du det overordnede ansvar for cocktailbarens daglige drift, udvikling og personale. Du bliver den faglige drivkraft bag baren og får en central rolle i at sætte standarden for både kvalitet, kreativitet og gæsteoplevelser.

Du arbejder i tæt samarbejde med Restaurantchefen og indgår som en vigtig del af restaurantens samlede ledelsesteam. Med reference til Restaurantchefen har du selvstændigt ansvar for cocktailbaren og dens medarbejdere.

Dine ansvarsområder omfatter:

  • Det overordnede ansvar for cocktailbarens daglige drift og performance

  • Ledelse, udvikling og motivation af barens bartendere

  • Rekruttering, onboarding og oplæring af nye medarbejdere i samarbejde med Restaurantchefen

  • Udvikling og løbende fornyelse af cocktailkortet med fokus på kreativitet, kvalitet og sæsonens råvarer

  • Sikring af høje faglige standarder inden for cocktails, præsentation og værtskab

  • Ansvar for barens indkøb, lagerstyring, vareforbrug og omkostningsoptimering

  • Udvikling af nye cocktailkoncepter og kreative drinksoplevelser

  • Sikring af struktur, arbejdsrutiner og effektive arbejdsgange bag baren

  • Tæt samarbejde med køkkenet og Restaurantchefen om vin- og cocktailparringer samt restaurantens samlede gæsteoplevelse

  • Aktiv deltagelse i driften, hvor du går forrest og viser vejen for dit team

Du er både en kreativ cocktailprofil og en stærk leder. Du formår at kombinere passionen for håndværket med struktur, økonomisk forståelse og evnen til at udvikle mennesker.

VI SØGER DIG, DER

  • Har minimum 3 års erfaring fra cocktail- eller restaurantbranchen

  • Har solid erfaring med cocktailhåndværk og en naturlig interesse for nye teknikker, smage og trends

  • Gerne har erfaring fra en lignende rolle som Barchef, Assistant Bar Manager eller Lead Bartender

  • Har erfaring med personaleledelse eller et naturligt talent for at motivere og udvikle andre

  • Har forståelse for økonomi, vareforbrug, lagerstyring og indkøb

  • Brænder for værtskab og for at skabe ekstraordinære gæsteoplevelser

  • Arbejder struktureret og tager naturligt ansvar for både kvalitet og drift

  • Er kreativ, initiativrig og ikke bange for at udfordre det eksisterende

  • Er en holdspiller med positiv energi og en professionel tilgang til samarbejde

Du har ambitioner på barens vegne og motiveres af at skabe noget, der skiller sig ud. Du går op i detaljen, men forstår samtidig betydningen af det store billede.

VI TILBYDER

  • En central lederstilling med selvstændigt ansvar for cocktailbaren

  • Mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på barens identitet, cocktailkort og udvikling

  • Stor kreativ frihed til at eksperimentere og udvikle nye cocktailoplevelser

  • Mulighed for at udvikle og forme dit eget barteam

  • Et tæt samarbejde med Restaurantchefen og resten af restaurantens ledelsesteam

  • En dynamisk og ambitiøs arbejdsplads med højt til loftet

  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling

  • En del af en kvalitetsdrevet koncern med stærke værdier og udviklingsmuligheder

  • Konkurrencedygtig lønpakke

HVORFOR VÆLGE SUKAIBA?

Hos Sukaiba er ambitionerne høje, men fællesskabet er mindst lige så vigtigt. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem engagement, gensidig respekt og en fælles passion for det, vi laver.

Vi ønsker at skabe en cocktailbar, hvor kreativitet, kvalitet og personlighed går hånd i hånd – og hvor både gæster og medarbejdere har lyst til at komme igen.

Vi er en del af Norrlyst Koncernen, hvor der er gode muligheder for sparring, udvikling og karriere på tværs af organisationen.

PRAKTISK

Stillingen er på fuld tid med opstart hurtigst muligt – men vi venter gerne på den rette kandidat.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Send din ansøgning og dit CV – vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!
